scripts.text:
[Spokesperson]
Good day.
Rekenber is recruiting adventurers for an excavation project that takes place in Phantasmagorika, the newly discovered ruins in Juperos.
scripts.translation:
[發言人]
您好。
雷根貝勒正在招募冒險者，參與優配擂斯新發現遺蹟“幻象嘉年華”的發掘專案。

scripts.text:
[Spokesperson]
If you're interested, just come as you are.
Everything you need for the excavation will be provided by Rekenber.
scripts.translation:
[發言人]
有興趣的話，直接報名即可。
發掘所需的一切物資都由雷根貝勒提供。

scripts.text:
[Spokesperson]
Join us for adventure at the newly discovered ruins in Juperos,
an ancient city whose scientific knowledge has fueled the development of modern civilization.
scripts.translation:
[發言人]
加入我們，一同探索朱佩羅斯新發現的遺蹟吧！
這座古城的科學知識曾推動現代文明發展。

scripts.text:
[Spokesperson]
If you'd like to join, then form an excavation team and fill out your application.
scripts.translation:
[發言人]
想加入的話，請組建一支發掘隊並提交申請。

scripts.text: Excavation team? Application?
scripts.translation: 發掘隊？申請？

scripts.text: Phantasmagorika?
scripts.translation: 幻象嘉年華？

scripts.text: Bye.
scripts.translation: 再見。

scripts.text:
[Spokesperson]
We're recruiting teams of excavators for the research of Phantasmagorika, the newly discovered ruins.
This project requires expertise in various fields, so we've decided to recruit
teams of excavators instead of individuals.
scripts.translation:
[發言人]
我們正在為研究新發現的幻象嘉年華遺蹟招募發掘隊。
專案需要多個領域的專長，所以我們決定招募團隊，而非個人。

scripts.text:
[Spokesperson]
You can register for the excavation project,
and help us however you can.
Registered excavators receive special benefits and commodities
scripts.translation:
[發言人]
你可以登記參加發掘專案，
盡力協助我們。
登記的發掘人員可獲得特別福利和物資，

scripts.text:
[Spokesperson]
in exchange for information that they discover in the ruins. We'll use the information to research the ruins.
Even if you fail to find useful information, we'll reward you just for your participation.
scripts.translation:
[發言人]
作為交換，請提供你在遺蹟中發現的情報，我們會用來研究遺蹟。
即使沒有發現有用資訊，只要參與，我們也會給予獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Spokesperson]
If you want to join the project, please go submit your application to the Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[發言人]
想加入專案的話，請到樂園團提交申請。

scripts.text:
[Spokesperson]
An ancient site was just discovered in Juperos.
It was hidden at the end of a long tunnel.
scripts.translation:
[發言人]
朱佩羅斯剛發現一處古代遺址，
它藏在一條長隧道的盡頭。

scripts.text:
[Spokesperson]
Rekenber has named the site ^4d4dffPhantasmagorika^000000
and commenced an excavation.
scripts.translation:
[發言人]
雷根貝勒將遺址命名為^4d4dff幻象嘉年華^000000，
並已開始發掘。

scripts.text:
[Spokesperson]
We're hoping to find more advanced mado gears and a higher level of scientific knowledge than what was ever discovered in the Juperos region.
scripts.translation:
[發言人]
我們希望能找到比朱佩羅斯地區以往發現的更先進魔導機甲，以及更高深的科學知識。

scripts.text:
[Spokesperson]
Rekenber is looking for talented adventurers for the excavation of Phantasmagorika.
Feel free to join us anytime!
We need you!
scripts.translation:
[發言人]
雷根貝勒正在招募優秀冒險者，參與幻象嘉年華的發掘。
歡迎隨時加入！
我們需要你！

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
Welcome back,
{0}. I don't know how we can survive without you.
scripts.translation:
[秘書萊姆·艾弗諾]
歡迎回來，
{0}。沒有你，我們真不知道該怎麼辦。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
Have you heard?
An ancient site was just discovered in Juperos.
Rekenber is recruiting adventurers for the excavation of the place,
scripts.translation:
[秘書萊姆·艾弗諾]
聽說了嗎？
朱佩羅斯剛發現一處古代遺址。
雷根貝勒正在招募冒險者參與發掘，

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
and we've decided to join it.
The Captain wants to see you about that.
scripts.translation:
[秘書萊姆·艾弗諾]
我們決定加入。
船長想和你談談這件事。

scripts.text: I didn't know you had a captain.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你們還有船長。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
What, did you think I was running this gig alone?
The Mistre--I mean, the Captain is rarely excited about anything, and this is one of those rare occasions. You should meet her.
scripts.translation:
[秘書萊姆·艾弗諾]
怎麼，你以為這攤事只有我一個人在管？
艦長...我是說，船長平時很少這麼興奮。這可是難得一見，你該去見見她。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
Her office is to the far left on the second floor.
scripts.translation:
[秘書萊姆·艾弗諾]
她的辦公室在二樓最左邊。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
You need to Join the Eden Group first.
scripts.translation:
[秘書萊姆·艾弗諾]
你得先加入樂園團。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
I also come up here sometimes to attend some business.
Actually the central room is mine.
scripts.translation:
[秘書萊姆·艾弗諾]
我有時也會上來處理公務。
其實中間那間房是我的辦公室。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
Welcome back,
{0}. I don't know how we can survive without you.
scripts.translation:
[秘書萊姆·艾弗諾]
歡迎回來，
{0}。沒有你，我們真不知道該怎麼辦。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
The Captain is waiting for you.
Her office is to the far left from here.
I'll see you again later.
scripts.translation:
[秘書萊姆·艾弗諾]
船長正在等你。
她的辦公室就在左手邊。
回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
It seems everything went smoothly with the Captain.
Let's move to the central room, shall we?
We have a guest waiting
to talk us about something.
scripts.translation:
[秘書萊姆·艾弗諾]
看來你和船長談得很順利。
我們去中間的房間吧？
有位客人正在等著
和我們談些事情。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
I'll be here rooting for you.
Don't worry about support.
I'll see that you get everything you need.
scripts.translation:
[秘書萊姆·艾弗諾]
我會在這裡支援你的。
後勤不用擔心，
我會確保你拿到所需的一切。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
The excavation seems to be going well so far.
The item Dr. Atnad was interested in is also on Rekenber's radar; it should be appraised highly.
scripts.translation:
[秘書萊姆·艾弗諾]
目前發掘工作進展順利。
阿特納德博士看中的那件物品也引起了雷根貝勒的注意，應該能賣個好價錢。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
Have you heard?
An ancient site was just discovered in Juperos.
Rekenber is recruiting adventurers for the excavation of the place,
scripts.translation:
[秘書萊姆·艾弗諾]
聽說了嗎？
朱佩羅斯剛發現一處古代遺址。
雷根貝勒正在招募冒險者參與發掘，

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
and we've decided to join it.
The Captain wants to see you about that.
scripts.translation:
[秘書萊姆·艾弗諾]
我們決定加入。
船長想和你談談這件事。

scripts.text: I didn't know you had a captain.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你們還有船長。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
What, did you think I was running this gig alone?
The Mistre--I mean, the Captain is rarely excited about anything, and this is one of those rare occasions. You should meet her.
scripts.translation:
[秘書萊姆·艾弗諾]
怎麼，你以為這攤事只有我一個人在管？
艦長...我是說，船長平時很少這麼興奮。這可是難得一見，你該去見見她。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
Her office is to the far left on the second floor.
scripts.translation:
[秘書萊姆·艾弗諾]
她的辦公室在二樓最左邊。

scripts.text:
[Secretary Lime Evenor]
Thank you for helping the doctors focus on their work.
Keep up the good work.
scripts.translation:
[秘書萊姆·艾弗諾]
謝謝你幫醫生們專心工作。
繼續加油。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Lime]
{0}. Please come this way.
Let me introduce you to
Archaeologist Aures of the Atnad Excavation Team.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆]
{0}，請這邊走。
讓我為你介紹一下
阿特納德發掘隊的考古學家奧雷斯。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
This room is for employees only.
If you need a place to rest, please use the next room.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆]
這裡是員工專用區。
需要休息的話，請去隔壁房間。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
The Captain is in the next room.
It's to the left.
Please talk to the Captain first.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆]
船長在隔壁房間，
就在左邊。
請先去和船長談談。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
The excavation site is connected to Juperos,
so you should move to Juperos first.
The excavation project has been promoted widely, so you won't have a problem finding the representative.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆]
發掘地點與朱佩羅斯相連，
所以你得先去朱諾。
發掘專案已經廣為宣傳，到了那裡很容易找到負責人。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
How's the situation at the excavation site?
Sigh, why can't Ian just forgive his daughter?
scripts.translation:
[萊姆]
發掘現場情況怎麼樣？
唉，伊恩為什麼就不能原諒女兒呢？

scripts.text:
[Lime]
Dr. Aures, this is {0}, who will assist you in Phantasmagorika.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆]
奧雷斯博士，這位是{0}，之後會在幻象嘉年華協助你。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Nice to meet you. My name is Aures.
Every member of my team is old and feeble. We really can use some young blood like you.
Welcome to the team.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
幸會，我叫奧雷斯。
隊員們都上了年紀，體力也不如從前。正需要你這樣年輕的新血加入。
歡迎入隊。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
It seems everything went smoothly with the Captain.
Your job is simple:
just help Dr. Aures and his Atnad Excavation Team.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆]
看來你和船長談得很順利。
你的工作很簡單：
協助奧雷斯博士和阿特納德發掘隊就行。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
I expect you'll spend most of your time running errands
and doing things that require physical stamina since all the members of the team are past their prime.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆]
隊員們都過了壯年，
我想你大部分時間得跑腿，或是做些需要體力的工作。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
That's right. All of us retired a long time ago.
This excavation will probably be the last excavation we do before we die.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
沒錯，我們早就退休了。
這次發掘大概是我們有生之年最後一次了。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
If Lime didn't help us, we would have changed our minds at the entrance to that place.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
要不是萊姆幫忙，我們恐怕剛到遺址入口就打退堂鼓了。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
Please don't say that.
You're the most experienced archaeologists I've met.
By the way, how's Dr. Atnad?
scripts.translation:
[萊姆]
別這麼說。
你們是我見過經驗最豐富的考古學家。
對了，阿特納德博士怎麼樣了？

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Atnad? Don't get me started.
He's as stubborn as his daughter, if not more.
She liquidated her inheritance and left when she couldn't hear from her father.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
阿特納德？別提了。
他和女兒一樣固執，甚至有過之而無不及。
女兒一直收不到父親的訊息，最後變賣了繼承的財產離開了。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
He didn't keep touch with his family for years. When he found out his house was sold,
he lashed out and went off the grid,
and he's still angry at her.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
他好幾年都沒和家人聯絡。得知房子被賣掉後，他大發雷霆，從此銷聲匿跡，至今還在生女兒的氣。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
And we're stuck in the middle of their mind game.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆]
結果我們夾在他們父女之間，左右為難。

scripts.text: Who are they?
scripts.translation: 他們是誰？

scripts.text: Cut to the chase, please.
scripts.translation: 請說重點。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Let me tell you. When Lime came to us,
we all wondered why a famous company like Eden Group would support a ragtag bunch of old men like us.
Then we found out they're father and daughter.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
我來解釋吧。萊姆來找我們時，我們都納悶：樂園團這麼有名的大公司，為什麼要支援我們這群老傢伙？
後來才知道，原來她和隊長是父女。

scripts.text: Father and daughter? Who?
scripts.translation: 父女？誰和誰？

scripts.text:
[Lime]
Oh, didn't the Captain tell you?
Her father is the leader of the Atnad Excavation Team.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆]
哦，船長沒告訴你嗎？
她父親就是阿特納德發掘隊的隊長。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
When I first suggested we should join the project,
she wanted to support the Atnad Excavation Team.
At first I was thinking more along the lines of merging the team.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆]
我最初提議參加這個專案時，
船長就想支援阿特納德發掘隊。
我原本還想過把兩支隊伍合併。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
Rekenber takes care of the financial aspects of the project, while we handle the manpower.
Then I realized the leader of the team is the father of my boss's.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆]
雷根貝勒負責專案經費，我們負責派人。
後來我才知道，隊長竟然是我老闆的父親。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
I want to support the team to the best of my ability,
but their rocky relationship is getting in the way.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆]
我想盡全力支援這支隊伍，
可他們父女關係緊張，事情因此變得棘手。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Ian, I mean the old Atnad, welcomed your proposal with open arms.
Then he hit the roof when he realized your captain was his daughter.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
伊恩，我是說老阿特納德，一開始非常歡迎萊姆的提議。得知你們船長就是他女兒後，他卻勃然大怒。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
I don't understand the hangup.
I mean she's his daughter, for the goodness's sake.
I think you should mediate between the two.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
我真不懂他有什麼好糾結的。那可是他的女兒啊！
我覺得你該幫他們調解一下。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
I hope this collaboration will be a chance for them to reconcile with each other.
Well, we should move to the site now.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆]
希望這次合作能成為他們和解的契機。
好了，我們該去發掘現場了。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
Indeed. Before we go, let's talk about what we can expect at the site.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆]
沒錯。出發之前，先說說現場的情況吧。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
Aures, Luke will come with you.
{0}, you can go to Phantasmagorika whenever you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆]
奧雷斯，盧克會陪你一起去。
{0}，準備好後隨時可以前往幻象嘉年華。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
It's accessible through Juperos,
so move to Juno first, then get to the entrance to Juperos from there.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆]
那裡要經由朱佩羅斯前往。
先去朱諾，再從那裡前往朱佩羅斯入口。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Rekenber has been promoting this project across the continent,
and has succeeded in bringing in more people than you can imagine.
Just look for a big crowd, and you won't miss the place. See you when you get there.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
雷根貝勒在整個大陸宣傳這個專案，吸引到的人比你想像的還多。
找人最多的地方就行，絕不會錯過。到現場見。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
Everything should be easy enough for you,
though you'll have to register with Rekenber for the excavation.
You can register as an individual excavator, but I'd prefer if you do it as a member of the Atnad Excavation Team instead.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆]
這些事對你來說應該不難，
不過參加發掘前得先向雷根貝勒登記。
你可以登記為個人發掘者，但我更希望你加入阿特納德發掘隊，以隊員身份登記。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
Once your registration goes through, you can start working for the Atnad Excavation Team,
and everything else will take care of itself.
Thank you for doing this.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆]
登記通過後，你就能開始為阿特納德發掘隊工作，其他事情也會順利安排好。
謝謝你願意幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Lime]
I'm sorry, but he's our guest.
And this office is for Eden Group employees only.
The dormitory is the next room.
scripts.translation:
[萊姆]
抱歉，他是我們的客人。
而且這間辦公室只對樂園團員工開放。
宿舍在隔壁。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
I'll see you again at the excavation site, yeah?
The Eden Group has hired an escort for me, so I'll be traveling with him.
See you at the site.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
那我們發掘現場見吧？
樂園團給我安排了護衛，我會和他同行。
現場見。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Oh, you came.
I came here often.
I feel sorry for Luke, for he has to travel so often because of me.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
哦，你來了。我以前常來這裡。
總讓盧克為了我來回奔波，真過意不去。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
It's great to have a place where I can come anytime I want. It's been years since I had a place I could call home.
Hah hah hah!
I'll see you at the excavation site.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
能有個隨時想來就來的地方真好。我已經很多年沒有自己的家了。
哈哈哈！
發掘現場見。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Hey, Lime.
We have a guest.
...
scripts.translation:
[盧克]
嘿，萊姆。
有客人來了。
...

scripts.text:
[Luke]
...
I've got nothing to say to you.
scripts.translation:
[盧克]
...
我沒什麼話跟你說。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Hmm...
- You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Manager Michelle]
Wait. Which excavation team are you from?
...You're independent.
Did you register independently? Do you have a referral?
scripts.translation:
[管理員米歇爾]
等等，你屬於哪支發掘隊？
...你是獨立發掘者。
你是個人登記的嗎？有推薦信嗎？

scripts.text:
[Manager Michelle]
Wait.
Are you a participant of the Phantasmagorika excavation project?
scripts.translation:
[管理員米歇爾]
等等。
你是幻象嘉年華髮掘專案的參與者嗎？

scripts.text:
[Manager Michelle]
Just clear the tunnel of monsters,
and report to the Central Command Center.
Thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[管理員米歇爾]
清理隧道里的魔物，
然後向中央指揮中心報告。
謝謝幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Manager Michelle]
[Manager Michelle]
Are you looking for a new job?

如果你以前為樂園團工作過，拿到他們的推薦信應該不難。

抱歉。

樂園團的，明白了。

這是你們隊伍的發掘成果啊。
看來你們一直在研究核心區域。

[路易斯]
調查時間雖短，你們隊伍卻已經取得了不少成果。

[Louis]
The upper management is interested in

管理層很想

其他學者和發掘者只能做些表面觀察，

明天見。

[Louis]

謝謝。
廣場是主要的發掘區域。
如果能從你摧毀的機器上發現什麼就好了。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Things seems to have settled.
The workers will resume their work soon.
They're not fighters, so they're usually passive in times like this.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
情況似乎穩定下來了。
工人們很快就能復工。
他們不是戰鬥人員，遇到這種情況通常只能被動應對。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
I have other volunteers to take care of monsters at the Plaza, the main excavation point.
You should rest.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
我已經安排其他志願者去處理主發掘區廣場的魔物了。
你先休息吧。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Are you concerned about the machines at the main excavation point?
It's true that some of them are hypersensitive and aggressive,
and I agree they are threatening to our work.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
你擔心主發掘區的機器嗎？
確實有些機器反應過度、攻擊性強，
我也認為它們會威脅發掘工作。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
[Louis]
Is that so?
Let me know if you notice anything peculiar.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
是嗎？
發現什麼異常就告訴我。

scripts.text: I'll go.
scripts.translation: 我去。

scripts.text: Decline.
scripts.translation: 拒絕。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Of course, your priority is the excavation.
I'll look for someone else.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
當然，發掘才是你的首要任務。
我另找人去。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Good.
Thank you in advance.
Please be careful!
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
好，先謝過你。
請多加小心！

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Thank you for your hard work.
Our workers will be grateful to you for keeping them safe.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
辛苦了。
工人們會感謝你保護了他們。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
If you can take care of them, then I can officially put you on the task,
so you'll be rewarded accordingly. Rekenber never takes your service for granted.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
如果你能處理這些魔物，我就正式把任務交給你，並按規定發放報酬。雷根貝勒不會虧待幫忙的人。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Is that so?
Let me know if you notice anything peculiar.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
是嗎？
發現什麼異常就告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Miyo]
Please come in.
Where do you hurt?
scripts.translation:
[美代]
請進。
您哪裡不舒服？

scripts.text: HP/SP full recovery 5,000 z
scripts.translation: HP/SP完全恢復 5,000 Zeny

scripts.text: HP/SP half recovery 2,000 z
scripts.translation: HP/SP恢復一半 2,000 Zeny

scripts.text:
[Miyo]
...Look at you and you
can't pay for the treatment fee?
scripts.translation:
[美代]
...瞧你這樣子，
連治療費都付不起嗎？

scripts.text:
[Miyo]
Oh, you're exhausted.
Let me restore {0} energy.
I'm offering a 10% discount to the official excavators.
Smile, and you'll feel better.
scripts.translation:
[美代]
哎呀，你累壞了。
我來幫你恢復{0}點能量。
正式發掘人員可享九折優惠。
笑一笑，感覺會好些哦。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text:
The old archaeologist has his back toward you, working on something.
You shouldn't disturb him.
scripts.translation:
那位老考古學家正背對著你忙著什麼。
還是別打擾他吧。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Ah, welcome.
I've been waiting for you.
First things first: you should go register with the Central Command Center.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
啊，你來了。
我一直在等你。
先去中央指揮中心登記吧。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Your name is already on the list. Just go check in with the center.
Or you won't have full access to this area.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
名單上已經有你的名字了，去指揮中心報到就行。
否則你無法進入這一區域的所有地方。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Come back when you're done. I'll introduce you to the other members.
Go on.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
辦完後回來，我把其他隊員介紹給你。
去吧。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Ah, you're back.
Say hello to our leader, Ian Atnad.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
啊，你回來了。
來見見我們的隊長伊恩·阿特納德。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
...Rookie.
I don't have time for rookies. Send them back!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
...新人。
我沒空照顧新人，叫他回去！

scripts.text:
[Aures]
You're doing it again.
We're old now. We need help!
Stop being so stubborn.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
你又來了。
我們都老了，需要幫手！
別這麼固執。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
...Hey, rookie.
Did my daughter send you to spy on me?
Tell me!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
...喂，新人。
我女兒派你來監視我的嗎？
說！

scripts.text: I came to help.
scripts.translation: 我是來幫忙的。

scripts.text: I don't know what you're talking about.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你在說什麼。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Hm? Don't you know who my daughter is?
Well, we should leave it that way.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
嗯？你不知道我女兒是誰？
那最好就別知道。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
That means you know who my daughter is.
Do you really think you can work with me?
Knowing who I am?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
既然知道我女兒是誰，
你還覺得自己能跟我共事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Well, fine.
Let's get to work.
I want to know if you can follow my orders.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
行吧。
開始幹活。
我倒要看看你聽不聽我的命令。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Ian, you're helpless.
Well, welcome to the team, young adventurer.
Some of the things we're planning are physically challenging, not to mention dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
伊恩，你真拿他沒辦法。
歡迎加入隊伍，年輕的冒險者。
我們安排的工作有些很耗體力，而且相當危險。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Enough. Rookie, come over here.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
夠了。新人，過來。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
I'm sorry.
You'd better go.
Don't let him get on your nerves.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
抱歉，你還是先過去吧。
別把他的話放在心上。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Thank you for your patience with Ian.
He wasn't always like that.
He's doing it on purpose.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
謝謝你對伊恩這麼有耐心。
他以前不是這樣的。
他是故意刁難你。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
If you're done with him, I can use your help.
We have one more member in the team.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
你和他談完後，我還需要你幫忙。
隊裡還有一位成員。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
He went to the Plaza to investigate the remains.
He's a young fellow named ^4d4dffLloyd^000000.
I sent Luke with him to keep him safe,
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
他去廣場調查遺蹟了。
是個叫^4d4dff勞埃德^000000的年輕人。
我派盧克陪著他，確保安全，

scripts.text:
[Aures]
but I want to know how much progress Lloyd has made with his investigation.
Could you go check up on him?
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
不過我想知道勞埃德的調查進展如何。
你能去看看他嗎？
謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Lloyd must be somewhere in the Verus Central Plaza.
Look for Luke. He should be near Lloyd.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
勞埃德應該在維魯斯中央廣場某處。
去找盧克，他應該就在勞埃德附近。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
He's the only young member aside from you.
The rest of the members of our team are as old as me, and couldn't make the trip.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
除了你，他是隊裡唯一的年輕人。
其他隊員都和我一樣老，沒法長途跋涉。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Please take good care of
Lloyd.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
請好好照看
勞埃德。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
How's Lloyd doing?
Ah, so you're helping him.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
勞埃德怎麼樣？
哦，原來你在幫他。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Thank you
for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
辛苦你了。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
They're here to work for us.
Stop thanking them.
They're spoiled as it is.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
他們是來給我們幹活的。
別謝他們。
他們已經夠嬌氣了。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Sigh, would you stop?
*Shaking his head*
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
唉，你能不能消停點？
*搖搖頭*

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Ah, you're back.
How's Lloyd doing?
He wants to camp there.
Wouldn't it be too dangerous? I guess Luke can keep him safe.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
啊，你回來了。
勞埃德怎麼樣？
他想在那裡紮營。
會不會太危險了？不過盧克應該能保護他。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Please come this way.
I wrote a report while waiting for you.
I want you to take it to Commander Louis at the Central Command Center.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
請這邊走。
等你的時候我寫了份報告。
麻煩你送到中央指揮中心交給路易斯指揮官。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
This may be a simple errand,
but it gives you an opportunity to get acquainted with the Commander.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
這差事雖然簡單，
但也能讓你有機會認識一下指揮官。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
We're old, so we don't care about fame. You're different.
Winning favor with Rekenber
can go a long way.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
我們上了年紀，不在乎名聲。你還年輕，不一樣。
得到雷根貝勒賞識，對你前途大有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Please take that report to Commander Louis.
Writing a report every day is a chore, but an important chore nonetheless.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
請把報告交給路易斯指揮官。
每天寫報告雖然麻煩，卻很重要。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
I've noticed Louis has been watching us. I hope that's a good sign.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
我發現路易斯一直在關注我們，希望這是個好兆頭。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Did you deliver the report?
Good.
You can take a break now.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
報告送到了嗎？
很好。
你可以休息了。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
No, you can't!
You've got work to do!
Come over here, now!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
不行！
你還有活要幹！
現在過來！

scripts.text:
[Aures]
I don't understand him sometimes.
I feel sorry for you.
I wish I could help.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
有時候我也搞不懂他。
真替你難受。
希望我能幫上忙。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Maybe the other youngsters can give you better advice.
^4d4dffWhy don't you consult Lloyd or Luke?^000000
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
也許其他年輕人能給你更好的建議。
^4d4dff去問問勞埃德或盧克吧？^000000

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Sigh, he's as stubborn as a mule.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
唉，他倔得像頭驢。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I heard that.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
我聽見了。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Then stop it
and stop harassing them.
The Eden Group won't be happy if it knows about this.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
那就別再找他們麻煩了。
樂園團要是知道這事，可不會高興。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
The Eden Group? *Snort* Who cares?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
樂園團？*哼* 誰在乎？

scripts.text:
[Aures]
You're helpless.
I'm really, really sorry about him.
You really should talk to those two.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
真拿他沒辦法。
他這樣我實在很抱歉。
你還是去找那兩個人談談吧。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
So you've found some clues, eh?
Hm, even I'm excited.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
你找到線索了？
嗯，連我都興奮起來了。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Please take that report to Commander Louis.
Writing a report every day is a chore, but an important chore nonetheless.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
請把報告交給路易斯指揮官。
每天寫報告雖然麻煩，卻很重要。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
I've noticed Louis has been watching us. I hope that's a good sign.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
我發現路易斯一直在關注我們，希望這是個好兆頭。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
You came back at the right time.
I've made some progress with my research with the Power Control Devices you brought.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
你來得正好。
用你帶來的動力控制裝置做研究，我已經有些進展了。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
I just finished writing a report about it
along with the energy source that Lloyd is studying.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
我剛寫完一份報告，
裡面也整理了勞埃德正在研究的能源資料。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Here's the report.
Please ^4d4dffbring it to Louis
at the Command Center^000000.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
報告在這裡。
請^4d4dff把它交給指揮中心的路易斯^000000。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Ian is working on Power Control Devices.
Lloyd is working on the power supply for the devices.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
伊恩在研究動力控制裝置，
勞埃德則在研究裝置的供能方式。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Well, that leaves me with the menial task of organizing documents.
Could you help those two?
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
我嘛，只剩下整理檔案這種雜活了。
你能去幫幫那兩個人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aures]
The quicker we gather research materials, the quicker we can report.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
研究材料收集得越快，我們就越快能提交報告。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Did you deliver the report?
It may be a simple errand,
but it gives you an opportunity to get acquainted with the Commander.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
報告送到了嗎？
雖然只是跑個腿，
但也能讓你有機會認識指揮官。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
We're old, so we don't care about fame. You're different.
Winning favor with Rekenber can go a long way.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
我們上了年紀，不在乎名聲。你還年輕，不一樣。
得到雷根貝勒賞識，對你前途大有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
So let's have you submit reports from now on.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
今後就由你來提交報告吧。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
It's time we write another report.
I'll do it after I'm done studying Power Control Devices.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
該寫下一份報告了。
等我研究完動力控制裝置就動筆。

scripts.text: - Cannot progress quest because you have too many items in your possession. -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
... that's distracting.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
...真礙事。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
What have you been loafing around for?
Who the hell is this?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
你在那兒磨蹭什麼？
這傢伙是誰？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
So, you said you will help us with our work?
Then let's see how well you do.
There is a plaza if you leave this area and go further inside.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
你說要幫我們幹活？
那就讓我看看你有幾斤幾兩。
離開這裡再往裡走，有個廣場。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
20 Power Control Devices.
Should be no problem for one who is recommended by that supposedly great person, should it?
Hm.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
我要20個動力控制裝置。
那個所謂大人物推薦來的人，應該辦得到吧？
哼。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
.. Hm..
Don't get smug because of this!
We will use that for research.
Hand over everything you have.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
...嗯...
別拿這點事就得意！
這些東西要拿來研究。
全都交出來。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
...I still don't trust you.
There's a thing called a contract so I'd like it you just quietly keep working.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
...我還是不信任你。
既然簽了契約，你就老老實實繼續幹活。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
....you..
Why don't you go find something to work on instead of playing around?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
...你啊...
別在這兒閒逛，找點活幹去。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Are you coming back from sending the report?
Good timing.
Bring me something to snack on.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
你送完報告回來了？
來得正好。
給我找點零嘴來。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Are you going to make me repeat myself?
Find me a ^4d4dffdelicacy that is simple to eat yet juicy and refreshing and has a neat finish^000000
and I will grant you what you want.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
還要我重複一遍嗎？
給我找一道^4d4dff方便入口、多汁清爽、回味利落的美味^000000，
我就答應你的要求。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
..Hm.
Giving up?
Are you really?
I didn't see you as someone who would give up so easily..?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
...嗯。
要放棄了嗎？
你確定？
我還以為你不會這麼輕易放棄呢...

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Hm.. is this it?
......Can I indeed eat this conveniently during work without separate silverware.
..Smells of freshly cooked meat.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
嗯...是這個嗎？
...工作時不用餐具就能吃，倒是挺方便。
...聞起來像剛烤好的肉。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Have you arrived?
Have you adjusted to the excavation site?
So what is it this time.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
你到了？
適應發掘現場了嗎？
這次又有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
You're finally here.
So, did you get any results?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
你總算來了。
有進展嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Find that child Arquien, and bring back the record player.
She must give me at least that much.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
去找那個叫阿奎恩的孩子，把留聲機帶回來。
她至少該把這個還給我。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I cannot tell what that child is up to.
If she has a problem with me tell her to come and say it to me directly!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
我真搞不懂那孩子在想什麼。
她要是對我有意見，就當面來告訴我！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Did you see some results this time?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
這次有發現什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
You will find the restricted area if you go to the connected path North-west of the plaza area.
We have an excavation permit so you can enter.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
從廣場區域往西北走，沿著連線通道就能找到管制區。
我們有發掘許可，你可以進去。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
This time too!
Why.. why is that child acting like this!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
又是這樣！
那孩子為什麼...為什麼要這樣！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Have you arrived?
In fact I have been waiting.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
你來了？
其實我一直在等。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I will leave deciphering the Memory Records up to you and Arquien for the time being.
Since you say you won't ask about the Last Exploration any more..
What is it today?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
暫時由你和阿奎恩負責解讀記憶記錄。
既然你說不再追問最後一次探索的事了...
今天有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
What are you doing? Hurry up.
^4d4dffRekenber Headquarters is in Lighthalzen^000000.
You go on ahead. Let's meet there.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
你在磨蹭什麼？快點。
^4d4dff雷根貝勒總部在拉赫^000000。
你先過去，我們在那裡碰頭。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
You can never know what will happen.
I guess I should be happy with exclusive rights to the Memory Records.
What is it today?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
誰也說不準接下來會發生什麼。
能獨佔記憶記錄的權利，我想也算值得高興吧。
今天有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Ian, why are you like this?
This young adventurer was dispatched here from the Eden Group.
He is here to help us.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
伊恩，你怎麼又這樣？
這位年輕冒險者是樂園團派來幫忙的。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
..Hm... Rookie.
I do not need such favors, send them back!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
...嗯...新人。
我不需要這種好意，叫他回去！

scripts.text:
[Aures]
I see he is acting like this again..
Do you think a bunch of old men can do this task easily?
Stop being so stubborn for a change.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
你看，他又來了...
你覺得一群老頭子能輕鬆完成這項工作嗎？
偶爾也別這麼固執。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
..Hey, Rookie.
Are you here to monitor me on my daughter's orders?
Is that it?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
...喂，新人。
你是奉我女兒的命來監視我的？
是這樣嗎？

scripts.text: Just here to help.
scripts.translation: 我只是來幫忙的。

scripts.text: That is news to me.
scripts.translation: 這我倒不知道。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Hum? You did not hear about my daughter?
Then I don't need to bring up such idle talk.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
嗯？你沒聽說過我女兒？
那就不必聊這種閒話了。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
...so you know about my relationship with my daughter?
So are you trying to stay silent and just do your work?
You are trying not to involve yourself?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
...所以你知道我和女兒的關係？
你是打算什麼也不說，只管埋頭幹活？
不想摻和進來？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Good.
Then I will order you to do something you really need right away.
Let's see how well you can follow my instructions.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
很好。
那我現在就安排一件急事給你做。
讓我看看你有多聽話。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
This fellow.. He is like this to the end.
Anyway, since we are here, I am at your service as well.
I'm afraid the work we want to do is a bit dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
這老傢伙真是固執到底...
既然都來了，我也隨時聽候差遣。
不過我們要做的事恐怕有些危險。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Stop talking nonsense and come here, Rookie.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
少說廢話，過來，新人。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Sorry for this.
Let's us go first.
I have your back.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
抱歉啊。
我們先走吧。
我會照應你的。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
There will be machines from a highly advanced civilization.
There is an essential device to make the machines run.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
那裡有來自高度發達文明的機器。
有一種關鍵裝置能讓機器運轉。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
For now, there is something temporarily called the ^4d4dffOperation Control Device^000000 because it is still under investigation.
Investigate the machine and collect 20 of the Operation Control Devices.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
還在調查中，所以暫時叫它^4d4dff動力控制裝置^000000。
去檢查那些機器，收集20個動力控制裝置。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I will see how well you work.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
我會看看你幹得怎麼樣。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Haha.. This guy is stiff as always.
Is it that hard to say one word of thanks for a job well done?
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
哈哈...他還是老樣子，死板得很。
工作做得不錯，連句謝謝都不肯說嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Away with you!
Why do you keep interfering.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
走開！
你怎麼老來礙事？

scripts.text:
[Aures]
It is one of the few joys this old man has, so what can you do.
I will thank you instead.
Anyway, thanks for your trouble.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
這可是我這老頭少有的樂趣之一，沒辦法。
我替他謝謝你。
總之，辛苦了。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
You will probably focus on this kind of work in the future.
We wanted to study these operation devices butwe didn't know how terrifying those machines were.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
以後你大概會經常做這類工作。
我們本想研究這些動力裝置，可之前不知道那些機器有多危險。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
I will write the report soon so I will ask for you help then as well.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
我很快要寫報告，到時還得請你幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
You two are getting along well.
Go away!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
你們倆倒是相處得不錯。
快走開！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
You're expecting a word of thanks to come out of me...
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
你還指望我說謝謝嗎...

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Hey. Leave that stubborn fellow and come here for a minute!
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
嘿，別理那個固執的傢伙，過來一下！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
...... huh.. what are you doing? Go!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
...嗯？你在幹什麼？走開！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I am saying this once more,
I don't think you are here just to help us.
I am sure Arquien is up to something.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
我再說一次，
我不信你只是來幫忙的。
阿奎恩肯定在搞什麼鬼。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
.....hm.
Quickly come back to me after you are done with what you are doing.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
...嗯。
你忙完手頭的事就趕緊回來。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Not the rations supplies here.. what is that?
Find some delicacy to stimulate my appetite since it's hot and stuffy.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
這兒沒有口糧...那是什麼？
天氣又熱又悶，找點開胃的美食來。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Hey buddy. What kind of delicacy are you looking for here?
Just take what Louis brought.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
嘿，夥計，你到底在找什麼美味？
直接拿路易斯帶來的東西不就好了。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Ah, you stay out of this.
This is for the rookie to handle by themself.
Find me a ^4d4dffdelicacy that is simple to eat yet juicy and refreshing and has a neat finish^000000!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
你別插手。
這是給新人的任務，讓他自己想辦法。
給我找一道^4d4dff方便入口、多汁清爽、回味利落的美食^000000！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
If you find what I want then I will listen to one wish of yours.
Are you not here in hopes of getting something?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
找到我想要的東西，我就答應你一個要求。
你來這裡不就是有所求嗎？

scripts.text:
In order to ask Ian Atnad about the ^4d4dffLast Exploration^000000
it seems a ^4d4dffdelicacy that is simple to eat yet juicy and refreshing and has a neat finish^000000 has to be found.
scripts.translation:
為了向伊恩·阿特納德打聽^4d4dff最後一次探索^000000，
看來得先找到一道^4d4dff方便入口、多汁清爽、回味利落的美食^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
If it's hard for you find it with that dimwitted head of yours then try to ask others at least!
Something that will suit my taste.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
你那笨腦袋找不到的話，至少去問問別人！
找點合我口味的東西。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
If what I requested is that difficult I will take it back.
However, you must leave this excavation team.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
要是我的要求對你來說太難，我可以收回。
不過你得退出發掘隊。

scripts.text: I must find the lost Beef Toast somewhere.
scripts.translation: 我得想辦法找到丟失的牛肉吐司。

scripts.text: Ian wipes his hands and slowly starts to eat the Beef Toast.
scripts.translation: 伊恩擦了擦手，慢慢開始吃牛肉吐司。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Um...
.....!
This... this flavor!
Packed with the juiciness of finely ground beef!
I can taste the flavor of direct fire..!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
嗯...
...！
這...這味道！
細細絞碎的牛肉，汁水飽滿！
還有炭火直烤的香氣...！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Exotic fruit and vegetables reel in the subtle greasiness of the oil!
...!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
異國水果和蔬菜恰到好處地化解了油膩！
...！

scripts.text: Try the leaves that are wrapped around the outside.
scripts.translation: 試試外面包著的葉子。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Indeed.. this can be consumed as well.
Rich juiciness and fresh salad.. sweet fruit..
A fresh finishing flavor to wrap all of it up..!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
確實...這也能吃。
濃郁的肉汁，新鮮的沙拉...香甜的水果...
最後還有清爽的餘味，完美收尾...！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
...Kid..
Not bad.
You have satisfied all the conditions I have laid out.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
...小子...
不錯。
你完全滿足了我提的條件。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I have no choice.
Alright. I predicted there was something you wanted.
A promise is a promise. What do you want from me?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
我也沒辦法。好吧，我早就猜到你有所求。
說過的話算數，你想要我做什麼？

scripts.text: To know about the Last Exploration
scripts.translation: 我想知道最後一次探索的事。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
... so that was it.
I see....
To talk about that..give me some time to think.
....
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
...原來如此。
我明白了...
關於那件事...給我點時間想想。
...

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I need time to organize it as well.
.......
Come back later.
Please.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
我也得花點時間整理思緒。
...
過些時候再來。
拜託了。

scripts.text: About the excavation project
scripts.translation: 關於發掘專案。

scripts.text: Converse
scripts.translation: 交談。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
It's good that you're here.
The access permit for the Laboratories and Research facilities dropped apparently.
So we plan to expand the investigation area..
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
你來得正好。
實驗室和研究設施的通行許可似乎下來了。
所以我們打算擴大調查範圍...

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
The position of our excavation team has improved quite a bit due to your actions.
Thanks to you we received permission to explore closed areas.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
多虧你的努力，我們發掘隊的地位提高了不少。
我們終於拿到許可，可以探索封鎖區域了。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
They say the Research facilities area is connected to the road going up from the right side of the plaza.
Well, if you get up there the corporate bastards will be there restricting access.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
聽說研究設施區連著廣場右側向上的道路。
不過到了那裡，公司那幫混蛋會攔著不讓進。

scripts.text: What about the Last Exploration!
scripts.translation: 那最後一次探索的事呢！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
..the Last Exploration, it wasn't much.
The exploration site was Juperos.
There were various goals but..
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
...最後一次探索，沒什麼特別的。
地點在朱佩羅斯。
當時有好幾個目標，不過...

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I know well that it was a major turning point for my life.
I feel like there is fog in my head.
And I think I will find another turning point here.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
我很清楚那是我人生的重要轉折點。
可我腦子裡像蒙了層霧。
我覺得自己會在這裡找到另一個轉折點。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
It is just a feeling though.
I don't think the place I've been looking for and this place are related.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
不過這只是我的感覺。
我一直在找的地方，應該和這裡沒什麼關係。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
So won't you help me for the time being?
....
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
所以眼下你願意幫幫我嗎？
...

scripts.text: I have no choice.
scripts.translation: 我也沒辦法。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Yes, this is the last task.
Arquien has to know, too.
We will start soon so come back when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
沒錯，這是最後一項任務。
阿奎恩也必須知道。
我們很快就開始，準備好後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
So we are trying to expand the investigating area.
But it seems there was a reason it was shut down.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
所以我們打算擴大調查範圍。
不過看來那裡被封鎖是有原因的。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
It seems there are a lot of machines in that area that react sensitively to organisms.
Furthermore there was a veil of peculiar energy..
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
那個區域有很多機器會對生物產生強烈反應。
而且還籠罩著一層奇異的能量...

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Check out the Research facilities area first.
Let me know if there is anything peculiar.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
先去研究設施區看看。
發現什麼異常就告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
If you find something worth risking danger for come back right away and tell me!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
要是發現什麼值得冒險的東西，馬上回來告訴我！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Let's look around as well instead of just working.
These kind of opportunities are rare.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
別光顧著幹活，也四處調查一下。
這種機會可不多。

scripts.text:
You're finally here.
So, did you get any results?
scripts.translation:
你總算來了。
有進展嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Hm...? Wh..what. What is that in your hand?!
How...can this be.
I didn't imagine I would see this here...?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
嗯...？什、什麼？你手裡拿的是什麼？！
怎、怎麼可能...
我沒想到會在這裡見到這個...

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Huh? What is it?
It looks like your eyes are going to pop out.
Let me share in the surprise.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
咦？怎麼了？
你眼珠子都快瞪出來了。
讓我也看看是什麼讓你這麼驚訝。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
This..this is.
Is a Memory Record.. Didn't you talk about this to me once?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
這、這是...
記憶記錄...你以前不是跟我說過這個嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
My great-grandparents had something that looked like this...
It is a type of recording medium that records voices and sounds.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
我的曾祖父母好像有過類似的東西...
這是一種能記錄人聲和聲音的媒介。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Ooh... Is it magic?
I know a bit of picture magic that can preserve images seen by the eye..
Is it something similar?
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
哦...這是魔法嗎？
我略懂一點能儲存眼中所見影像的魔法...
和那個類似嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
No. This is not an application of magic.
This is purely a product of science. I've seen my great-grandparents use this to listen to songs or record voices.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
不，這不是魔法。
這是純粹的科學產物。我見過曾祖父母用它聽歌、錄音。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
In my youth I thought it was merely a toy-like invention of my great-grandparents....
Now I wonder why they did not announce that technology.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
年輕時我只當它是曾祖父母做的玩具...
如今我倒想知道，他們為什麼沒公開這項技術。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
It is a memory when I was very young but it looks just like this.
..can we know the contents of the Memory Record with that.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
這是我小時候的記憶，不過它看起來確實一模一樣。
...我們能用它讀取記憶記錄裡的內容嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I need that! I see!
That..
...Ah....
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
我需要那個！我明白了！
那個...
...啊...

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Hey, there. Are you okay?
Isn't the device that can decipher it in your house?
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
喂，你沒事吧？
能解讀記憶記錄的裝置不是在你家嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aures]
You.. ah...
I see. Ahahahahaha..
This guy. You don't know where your house is?
Ahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
你...啊...
我懂了。啊哈哈哈...
你這傢伙，連自己家在哪都不知道？
啊哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
.... Didn't you say Arquien disposed of the house..?
We can easily figure it out if only we had the record player.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
...你不是說阿奎恩把房子賣掉了嗎？
只要有留聲機，我們就能輕鬆解讀了。

scripts.text: ..What? Why are you looking at me?
scripts.translation: ...什麼？你為什麼看著我？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
You're that child's informant!
So go there and bring back the ^4d4dffrecord player^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
你是那孩子的信使！
去把^4d4dff留聲機^000000帶回來。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
I see. The one who can easily talk to her right now is you.
If it's okay we would like to ask you to do so.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
我明白了。現在你最容易和她溝通。
方便的話，就請你去一趟吧。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
...Why in the world is she not going to give it!
Then are you going to go and listen to it every time?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
...她到底為什麼不肯交出來！
難道你要每次都跑去聽嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Well, that's not bad either.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
嗯，那倒也不錯。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Yeah, not bad.
Not!
Anyway.. Since it turned out like this you make sure to bring it. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
對，不錯。才怪！
總之，既然事情都這樣了，你一定要把它帶回來，聽見沒有？

scripts.text: Tell him the contents of the Memory Record.
scripts.translation: 告訴他記憶記錄裡的內容。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
...Any chance you misheard it?
Why is Atnad mentioned there?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
...你確定沒聽錯嗎？
裡面為什麼會提到阿特納德？

scripts.text:
[Aures]
You never know.
Since you had the record thing in your house, could it be you are a descendant of this city?
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
誰知道呢。
你家裡既然有那種留聲機，難道你是這座城市的後裔？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I am... a descendant of this city..Verus?
Then why has this place been uncovered now?
Shouldn't we have known of this place much sooner?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
我是...這座城市...維魯斯的後裔？
那這裡為什麼現在才被發現？
我們不應該早就發現這裡了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
No no. It was strange.
That's why Juperos.. That's why Juperos wasn't unfamiliar to me so I latched on.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
不，不對勁。
難怪我總覺得朱佩羅斯...朱佩羅斯對我來說並不陌生，所以才一直追查下去。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
If my ancestors are of this city.. why did they keep it a secret?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
如果我的祖先來自這座城市...為什麼要隱瞞？

scripts.text: That we don't know.
scripts.translation: 我們也不知道。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Yes.. yes. Of course we do not know.
It seems we will have to find more of those Memory Records to know more.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
是啊...當然不知道。
看來得找到更多記憶記錄，才能弄清楚真相。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I am sorry, but.. you went to the Research facilities, right?
Do you know of the enormous underground facility discovered near the laboratories?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
抱歉...你去過研究設施區了吧？
聽說實驗室附近發現了一處巨大的地下設施。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
First time hearing of it?
.. It seems things like Memory Records are being found in that underground facility as well.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
你第一次聽說嗎？
...看來那處地下設施裡也發現了記憶記錄之類的東西。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Let's take the initiative before the others start to get interested.
The others can't decipher the messages anyway.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
趁別人還沒注意到，我們先下手為強。
反正他們也看不懂那些資訊。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
And, if we gather enough Memory Records.....
Go to Arquien and find out the... ugh... contents.
Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
還有，如果我們收集到足夠多的記憶記錄...
就去找阿奎恩查明...呃...裡面的內容。
聽明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
But I hear there are strange robots that are acting aggressively so be careful.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
不過聽說那裡的機器人很古怪，攻擊性也強，小心點。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Come back after you find the entry path to the underground facility there.
Remember ^4d4dffcollecting Memory Records from the laboratories is the goal^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
找到通往地下設施的入口後就回來。
記住，^4d4dff目標是從實驗室收集記憶記錄^000000。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
At least five? We need five to decipher it right?
Collect them and go to Arquien.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
至少要五個？解讀需要五個，對吧？
收集好後去找阿奎恩。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
What? She wants to participate in this project too?
She will regularly decipher the Memory Records and send the results..?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
什麼？她也想參與這個專案？
她會定期解讀記憶記錄，再把結果發過來...？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
...Why is she doing this. And so suddenly..?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
...她為什麼突然要這麼做？

scripts.text:
[Aures]
It seems she's become aware of something as well.
Is this not a good thing?
Father and daughter can get along and figure out their ancestors' past.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
看來她也發現了些事情。
這不是好事嗎？父女倆還能一起了解祖先的過去。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
...Is it?. Is there no other way?
Anyway, you go and see the results.
You have to check if Arquien is doing it correctly.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
...是嗎？就沒有別的辦法？
不管怎樣，你去看看解讀結果。
確認阿奎恩有沒有弄錯。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
We need somebody to collect the Memory Records as well?
Ahahahahaha
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
還得有人去收集記憶記錄嗎？
啊哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Well, that's not untrue...
Anyway go along.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
嗯，說得也沒錯...
總之，去吧。

scripts.text: Is there something wrong?
scripts.translation: 有什麼不對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Something wrong? Something is wrong.
Something is very wrong.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
不對勁？當然不對勁。
大有問題。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chief Secretary]
Hello?
I am the Chief Secretary of Rekenber's Secretariat, W.H.
I have been waiting.
scripts.translation:
[雷根貝勒首席秘書]
您好？
我是雷根貝勒秘書處的首席秘書，W.H.
我等你們很久了。

scripts.text: Chairman Rekenber's secretary?
scripts.translation: 雷根貝勒會長的秘書？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chief Secretary]
That is right.
I serve Chairman Rekenber.
scripts.translation:
[雷根貝勒首席秘書]
沒錯。
我為雷根貝勒會長工作。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
So, what's the mighty Chairman's secretary doing in a place like this?
I thought there were reports on the excavation being separately sent?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
堂堂會長秘書，怎麼會來這種地方？
我以為發掘報告都是單獨提交的？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chief Secretary]
The chairman wants to meet all of you.
Come and visit the headquarters in Rihrtarzen anytime.
scripts.translation:
[雷根貝勒首席秘書]
會長想見你們所有人。
隨時都可以去拉赫的總部拜訪。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chief Secretary]
It would be better if you could visit as soon as possible..
We request the Memory Record content be left undisclosed for the time being.
scripts.translation:
[雷根貝勒首席秘書]
最好儘快前往...
目前請暫時不要公開記憶記錄的內容。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Why is that?
Why should we do that?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
為什麼？
我們為什麼要這麼做？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chief Secretary]
Hm.. I think I know what you are going to say but...
Let's just say the time is not right yet.
scripts.translation:
[雷根貝勒首席秘書]
嗯...我大概知道你想說什麼，不過...
只能說，現在還不是時候。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chief Secretary]
We invited you to discuss the details of that issue as well.
So it would better to visit soon, would it not?
We will be waiting.
scripts.translation:
[雷根貝勒首席秘書]
這次邀請你們，也是想商討那件事的細節。
所以還是儘快過來比較好，對吧？
我們等著你們。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
What..is.. going on here..
Hey Ian, did you get on the wrong side of the corporation?
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
這...到底是怎麼回事...
伊恩，你是不是惹上公司了？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I don't know!
We should go anyway since they told us to.
Hey you.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
我也不知道！
不過既然人家請我們去，就去一趟吧。喂，你。

scripts.text: Me?
scripts.translation: 我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Yes. You.
They say you have to accompany us.
Let's meet at the Rekenber Corporation Headquarters.
It's better to take care of things like this at once.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
對，就是你。
他們說你也得一起去。
雷根貝勒總部見。
這種事最好一次解決。

scripts.text: About the excavation project
scripts.translation: 關於發掘專案。

scripts.text: About the Memory Records
scripts.translation: 關於記憶記錄。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
If I think about it this kind of structure isn't bad either.
The content recorded in the Memory Records is what is important.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
仔細想想，這種安排也不錯。
記憶記錄裡的內容才是重點。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I cannot figure out what Arquien is thinking.
It would be so much better for me to bring back the Record player.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
我真猜不透阿奎恩在想什麼。
要是能把留聲機帶回來就好了。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Since I am getting results without moving a finger..
......Good.. I will think positively. Yeah.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
既然我什麼都不用做就能拿到成果...
...好吧...往好處想。對。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
What? She wants to participate in this project too?
She will regularly decipher the Memory Records and send the results..?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
什麼？她也想參與這個專案？
她會定期解讀記憶記錄，再把結果發過來...？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
It's odd she's like this now when she used to hate even dreaming of working.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
真奇怪，她以前連想都不想工作，現在怎麼變成這樣了？

scripts.text:
[Aures]
It seems she's become aware of something as well.
Is this not a good thing?
Father and daughter can get along and figure out their ancestors' past.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
看來她也發現了些事情。
這不是好事嗎？父女倆還能一起了解祖先的過去。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
...Is that so? Is there no other way?
Anyway, it seems we need your help.
You have to check if Arquien is doing it correctly.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
...是嗎？就沒有別的辦法？
不管怎樣，看來我們還得靠你幫忙。
去確認阿奎恩有沒有正確解讀。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
We need somebody to collect the Memory Records as well?
Ahahahahaha
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
還得有人去收集記憶記錄嗎？
啊哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Well, that's not untrue...
^4d4dffWork with Arquien for the time being.^000000
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
嗯，說得也沒錯...
^4d4dff暫時和阿奎恩一起工作吧。^000000

scripts.text: About the excavation project
scripts.translation: 關於發掘專案。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
The excavation project?
.. do you mean the Power Control Device?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
發掘專案？
...你是說動力控制裝置？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Are you talking about today's work?
It may be obvious but it is to look for Power Control Devices.
...
..You don't have to do it if you don't want to.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
你問今天的工作？
顯而易見，就是去找動力控制裝置。
...
...你不想做也可以不做。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
It's always the same.
It's ^4d4dff20 Power Control Devices^000000.
Since we're already here, I want to do this right so try not to mess up.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
每次都一樣。
就是^4d4dff20個動力控制裝置^000000。
既然來了，就給我好好幹，別搞砸。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
You got it right again.
....
What are you looking at?
Drop what you brought and leave.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
這次也做對了。
...
看什麼看？
把帶來的東西放下，然後走人。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
We are researching it now.
It's possible we will render it useless from the experiments.
Anyway I am busy now so leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
我們正在研究這些裝置。
實驗過程中可能會把它們弄壞。
我現在很忙，別來煩我。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
The Power Control Devices we recovered in the past are all broken.
They couldn't withstand all the experiments.
Just like the ones now.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
之前回收的動力控制裝置全都壞了，
經不起那些實驗。
這次的也一樣。

scripts.text: [Ian Atnad]
scripts.translation: [伊恩·阿特納德]

scripts.text: I will look for Power Control Devices.
scripts.translation: 我會去找動力控制裝置。

scripts.text: It is too hard.
scripts.translation: 太難了。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
You? You definitely said you will find them yourself?
I have no reason to reject this offer.
Since you said you will do it yourself.
scripts.translation:
你？你剛才不是說要自己去找嗎？
我沒理由拒絕。
既然你主動提出，就交給你了。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Collect 20 Power Control Devices this time as well.
If we can unravel the secret of Power Control Devices...
We should be able to fix the broken ones and use them ourselves, right?
It will be fun.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
這次也去收集20個動力控制裝置。
要是能解開它們的秘密...
說不定就能修好那些壞掉的，自己拿來用，對吧？
想想就有意思。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
... And.. I feel like I've seen it.. feels like I will know it.
Like I will remember. If I research and research until it is stuck in my brain I am sure something will come of it.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
...而且...我好像在哪見過它...感覺自己應該認識。
就像快要想起來了。只要不斷研究，讓它刻進腦子裡，我肯定能發現什麼。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
If you aren't here to work then go away.
You're distracting me.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
不是來幹活就走開。
別打擾我。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
......This time I will use it well without breaking it.
Let's slowly get into restoration as well.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
...這次我會小心使用，不把它弄壞。
也該慢慢研究怎麼修復了。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Arquien is like that too.
......Because she couldn't withstand it... ..
...Hoo..
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
阿奎恩也一樣...
...因為她承受不住...
...唉...

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
This is very dangerous,
It is best to leave here,
The front is about to face
the danger of extreme death.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
這裡非常危險，
最好趕緊離開。
前方即將面對
致命的危險。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
I've told you
everything I wanted to tell you.
I hope we'll meet again someplace else.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
我想告訴你的事情
都已經說完了。
希望我們能在別處再見。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
I don't have a story to tell you at this moment.
I'm trying to rest my mind.
Why don't you go
rest for a while?
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
我現在沒故事可講，
正好休息一下腦子。
你也不如去
歇一會兒？

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Adventurer,
what story
did you bring me?
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
冒險者，
你帶來了
什麼故事？

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Listen to my story.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
聽聽我的故事。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Until then,
stay safe.
I'm leaving for someplace else
in search of new stories to tell.
You'll be on your way, I'll be on my.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
在那之前，
保重。
我得去別處
尋找新的故事了。
你走你的路，我走我的路。

scripts.text: ^ff0000You have not yet met the requirements to complete the quest.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000你尚未滿足完成此任務的條件。^000000

scripts.text: Return the quest.
scripts.translation: 交還任務。

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Please be safe.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
保重。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Maybe you're not ready
for that task just yet.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
也許你還沒
準備好做那個任務。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Come back later,
and I'll have a new story ready for you.
Bye for now.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
過些時候再來，
我會為你準備一個新故事。
先告辭了。

scripts.text: - Tell your story. -
scripts.translation: - 講述你的故事。 -

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Maybe there's
more to it than that,
but we wouldn't know
because it's too late.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
事情也許
不止如此，
可惜現在說什麼
都太遲了。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Schwarzwald seems to be
split into
various political factions.
Political intrigues don't mean much
to wandering artists like me.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
修瓦爾茲巴爾德似乎
分裂成了
好幾個政治派系。
我這種四處漂泊的藝人，
可不懂什麼政治鬥爭。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Scholars are such a strange kind.
I can't fathom what joy they'd feel
in studying such a thing.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
學者真是奇怪。
我實在想不通
研究這種東西
有什麼樂趣。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Only the gods know
who's right
and who's wrong.
I believe that applies to those scientists as well.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
誰對誰錯，
只有神明知道。
我想那些科學家之間
也是如此。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
The advancement of technology doesn't always mean
the destruction of the old.
Technology cannot advance by itself.
Neither can medical science
and life research.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
科技進步
不一定就要
摧毀舊事物。
科技不會憑空發展，
醫學和生命研究
也一樣。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
I'm not sure if the same thing
won't happen
in this excavation site
because even I can sense a dangerous shadow looming over it.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
我不確定
這處發掘現場
會不會重演舊事，
因為連我都能感覺到
危險的陰影
正籠罩著這裡。

scripts.text: [Wandering Bard]
scripts.translation: [流浪詩人]

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Your story dampens my mood,
and I wasn't in a good mood to begin with.
Well, at least I'm glad to see you back in one piece.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
你的故事讓我心情更沉重了，
而我原本心情就不怎麼樣。
不過，看到你平安回來，我還是很高興。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
I'm proud of you, though:
you've become acquainted with the president
and carried out a secret mission for him.
And I'm also glad to see you back in one piece.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
不過我真為你感到驕傲：
你不但認識了會長，
還替他執行了秘密任務。
更讓我欣慰的是，你平安回來了。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Of course, to some people
my search for new stories
sounds meaningless.
I don't care, so long as I have
curious adventurers like you with whom to pass the time.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
有些人會覺得，
我到處搜尋新故事
毫無意義。
我不在乎，只要有你這樣好奇的冒險者
陪我打發時間就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Welcome back.
I really enjoyed this story of yours.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
歡迎回來。
我很喜歡你講的這個故事。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
If you ask me,
I can't say which side is right or wrong.
Can you?
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
要我說，
我也分不清誰對誰錯。
你呢？

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Welcome back.
I really enjoyed this story of yours.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
歡迎回來。
我很喜歡你講的這個故事。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Um,
at least that's what I've heard.
...Just forget I said that.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
嗯，
至少我是這麼聽說的。
...剛才的話就當我沒說。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
The general populace
only likes to hear about happy endings,
so let's focus on
the positive aspects of the story,
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
普通人
只愛聽圓滿的結局，
所以我們還是多講講
故事裡積極的一面吧，

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Welcome back.
instead of
the dark,
depressing ones.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
歡迎回來。
那些黑暗、
令人沮喪的部分，
就少提一些。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
And about the last person you've met,
um...
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
至於你最後遇到的那個人，
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Never mind. I shouldn't even have said that.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
算了，我不該提起這個。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
We can only watch
the factions conspire against each other
and hope for
the best.
As a bard, my duty is simply to spread the word to the public.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
我們只能看著各方勢力
彼此算計，
盼望事情能有個好結果。
身為吟遊詩人，我的職責就是把訊息傳給大眾。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
I'm glad to see you back in one piece.
And thank you
for such a valuable story.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
很高興你平安回來。
也謝謝你帶來這麼珍貴的故事。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Sigh, I hate to say this,
but this will have to be the last time
we share stories with each other.
Thank you for telling me all those interesting tales.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
唉，真不想這麼說，
但這大概是我們最後一次
分享彼此的故事了。
謝謝你告訴我這些有趣的經歷。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Please give me some time.
I want to make a new song
based on the story you've just told me.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
給我一點時間吧。
我想把你剛講的故事
寫成一首新歌。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Please take this.
I hope
it'll be useful for you.
I hope we'll meet again someplace else.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
這個拿去。
希望
對你有用。
但願我們能在別處再見。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
I have to leave
in search of new stories.
You'll be on your way, I'll be on my.
Be safe.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
我得離開了，
去尋找新的故事。
你走你的路，我走我的。
保重。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
You should rest and regroup in the meantime.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
趁這段時間
好好休息，整頓一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
In the Republic of Schwarzwald,
where science prevails over magic,
a giant corporation of men
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
在科學勝過魔法的
修瓦爾茲巴爾德共和國，
有一家由人類組成的
大型企業...

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Do you know the president of
the Republic of Schwarzwald?
Usually, commoners like you and me
could never dream of meeting such a prominent figure,
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
你聽說過修瓦爾茲巴爾德共和國的總統嗎？
一般平民百姓
根本不敢想像能見到
那樣的大人物，

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
I wonder where all these researchers
have come from.
They must be
from all over the globe,
seeking the thrills of discovering the unknown.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
這些研究人員
到底是從哪兒來的？
他們一定
來自世界各地，
為了探索未知、體驗發現的刺激而來。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Are these people
helping each other?
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
這些人
是在互相幫助嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Scholars. Where do they draw the line at their research?
Drifters like you and me
have no care for the world, and I'm glad for that.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
學者們啊，他們研究起來究竟有沒有底線？
我和你這樣的漂泊者
什麼都不在乎，反而自在。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
I've seen the same scenery
a long time ago,
when Odin Temple
was first discovered.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
很久以前，
奧丁神殿
剛被發現時，
我也見過類似的景象。

scripts.text: [Wandering Bard]
scripts.translation: [流浪詩人]

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
is rumored to conduct research
whose purpose is noble and questionable at the same time.
Do you know
what's going on behind the closed doors of the corporation?
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
據說那家企業正在進行某種研究，
目的既崇高又令人質疑。
你知道
公司那扇緊閉的大門後
究竟發生著什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
You should
look further into what that corporation is doing.
Please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
你該
繼續調查那家企業的所作所為。
小心行事。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
but rumor has it you can
if you can find his contact in Lighthalzen.
Not only can you meet the president,
but you can unlock some new adventure.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
不過傳聞說，
只要在拉赫找到他的聯絡人，
就能見到他。
不僅能見到總統，
還會開啟新的冒險。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Look for his contact,
and everything else will take care of itself.
Who knows?
The adventure of your life might await you.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
找到他的聯絡人，
其他事情就會水到渠成。
誰知道呢？
也許一生中最精彩的冒險正等著你。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
I think the most daring kind of people are
scholars and researchers,
like those at the Juno Library...
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
我覺得最無畏的人
就是學者和研究員，
比如朱諾圖書館裡的那些人...

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Oh, speaking of the Juno Library,
I know there's a scholar
who does the same kind of research,
you know,
looking at odd-looking things all day.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
說到朱諾圖書館，
我認識一位學者
也做類似的研究。
就是那種
整天盯著奇怪東西看的研究。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
You should
talk to that scholar.
He may open your eyes to a whole new world.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
你應該
去和那位學者談談。
他或許能帶你見識全新的世界。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Rumor has it there's a mad scientist
in Juno, and a group of people are
trying to thwart his dangerous research.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
聽說朱諾有個瘋狂科學家，
還有一群人正試圖阻止他進行危險的研究。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
I'd say the statement is biased.
Maybe the scientist is sound,
and those people are dangerous.
Who knows? I would steer clear of both of them, though, if I were you.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
我覺得這種說法有些偏頗。
也許那位科學家才是理智的，
那些人反而很危險。
誰知道呢？換作是我，會離他們雙方都遠遠的。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
In Hugel, there's a scholar
who's rumored to be obsessed with a dangerous experiment.
I want you to go find out
what it is he's after:
happiness or hollow ambition.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
毀葛有位學者，
據說沉迷於危險的實驗。
去查查他到底追求什麼：
幸福，還是虛無的野心。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
Oh, that reminds me
of the story about
the two--no, three people related to Odin Temple.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
哦，這讓我想起
奧丁神殿相關的
兩個人——不，是三個人的故事。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Bard]
I wonder if Hugel still has the signboard
to recruit excavators.
Would you go check it out?
I want to hear the story behind those excavators when you get back.
scripts.translation:
[流浪詩人]
不知道毀葛還掛著招募發掘者的告示嗎？
你能去看看嗎？
回來後我想聽聽那些發掘者背後的故事。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to continue. -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Nice to meet you. I'm Kesler, chief of the Phantasmagorika Police.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
幸會。我是凱斯勒，幻象嘉年華警察隊的隊長。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Welcome to the Phantasmagorika Police.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
歡迎來到幻象嘉年華警察隊。

scripts.text: The Phantasmagorika Police?
scripts.translation: 幻象嘉年華警察隊？

scripts.text: Is there anything I can do to help?
scripts.translation: 有什麼需要我幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Oh, do you want to know about us at the ^4E9867Phantasmagorika Police^000000? Why, thank you. Not many people are interested in what we do.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
哦，你想了解^4E9867幻象嘉年華警察隊^000000嗎？謝謝你關心我們的工作，很少有人對這些感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
You may wonder why such a fresh site needs a policing unit. Well, there's a valid reason.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
你可能會好奇，這種新開發的地方為什麼還要成立警隊。原因很充分。

scripts.text: What's that?
scripts.translation: 什麼原因？

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Have you heard of the ^F8081EDoom Prayers^000000?
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
你聽說過^F8081E末日祈禱團^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
They're a cult group propagating the end of the world. They vandalize in the name of their god.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
他們是宣揚世界末日的邪教組織，還打著神的旗號搞破壞。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
It's only recent that they appeared in Phantasmagorika, but they've done so much damage already that scholars and mercenaries have organized this policing unit.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
他們最近才出現在幻象嘉年華，卻已經造成不少破壞，所以學者和傭兵一起組建了這支警隊。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
The ^F8081EDoom Prayers^000000 are mainly sighted around the ^82ABE9Verus Central Plaza^000000. If you encounter them, feel free to teach them a lesson or two.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
^F8081E末日祈禱團^000000主要出現在^82ABE9維魯斯中央廣場^000000附近。遇到他們的話，就給他們點教訓吧。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Hah hah, we're short-staffed.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
哈哈，我們人手不太夠。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
I understand your enthusiasm, but you should focus on your training for now.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
我理解你的熱心，不過眼下還是專心訓練吧。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Thank you for offering to help, but we can manage on our own.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
多謝你願意幫忙，不過我們還應付得來。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
I'm sorry, what did you say?
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
抱歉，你剛才說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
[Police Chief Kesler]
Wow, you're the first person to ever offer help. We're spread thin, dealing with the Doom Prayers and everything else at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
哇，你是第一個主動提出幫忙的人。我們人手緊缺，還得同時對付末日祈禱團和其他事務。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Phantasmagorika is more dangerous than you think.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
幻象嘉年華比你想像的危險。

scripts.text: Is there anything I can do to help?
scripts.translation: 有什麼需要我幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Wow, you're the first person to ever offer help. We're spread thin, dealing with the Doom Prayers and everything else at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
哇，你是第一個主動提出幫忙的人。我們人手緊缺，還得同時對付末日祈禱團和其他事務。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
I haven't had time to hear about the work-related difficulties trat the members of my unit may be experiencing.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
我一直忙得抽不開身，還沒機會了解隊員們工作上遇到的困難。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Could you make a tour around Phantasmagorika and talk to the police officers?
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
你能在幻象嘉年華巡視一圈，和警員們聊聊嗎？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然可以。

scripts.text: Maybe later.
scripts.translation: 也許之後吧。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Oh, I thought you wanted to help.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
哦，我還以為你想幫忙呢。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
謝謝你。

scripts.text: You haven't met with all the members.
scripts.translation: 你還沒見過所有隊員。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Please come back when you have.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
見完他們再回來吧。

scripts.text: You've met with all my members. Thank you.
scripts.translation: 你已經見過所有隊員了。謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
I'm glad none of them--Salgran, Gerev, Seiden, and Piffs--are having problems.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
很高興薩爾格蘭、傑列夫、賽登和皮夫斯都沒遇到麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Please take this small token of my appreciation.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
請收下這份小禮物，聊表謝意。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
If you are not busy tomorrow, could you come back and help me again?
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
如果明天有空，能再回來幫我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Oh, is this your first time in Phantasmagorika?
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
哦，你第一次來幻象嘉年華嗎？

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
This site was only recently discovered, and therefore fairly safe. I can't think of anything you should be worried about...
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
這裡最近才被發現，目前還算安全。我想暫時沒什麼可擔心的...

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Oh, strike that--there's one thing.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
等等，我收回剛才的話——確實有一件事。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
This ^82ABE9Verus Excavation Site^000000 is safe, but if you're planning to move to the ^82ABE9Verus Central Plaza^000000, then make sure you're prepared for the worst.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
^82ABE9維魯斯發掘現場^000000還算安全，但如果你要去^82ABE9維魯斯中央廣場^000000，務必做好最壞的準備。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
By the way the excavation of this site just has begun, and everything in it must be kept in place until the excavation is over.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
這裡才剛開始發掘，在工程結束前，所有發現的東西都必須保持原樣。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
But those Doom Payers are making it impossible. Bah! %$#@#$#@
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
可那些末日祈禱團把一切都攪亂了。真是的！%$#@#$#@

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
I'm going bald, worrying over them so much. I didn't have much hair to begin with.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
我都快愁禿了，本來頭髮就不多。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
...
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
...

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Um, didn't mean to rant about my hair.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
呃，我不是想抱怨自己的頭髮。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Just be careful not to break anything that has been discovered in this site.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
總之，小心別破壞現場發現的任何東西。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Oh, didn't you bring some Doom Tokens a while ago?
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
哦，你之前不是帶來過末日代幣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
I guess you haven't left? You must like being here. So do I. Hah hah hah!
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
看來你還沒離開啊？你一定很喜歡這裡。我也是，哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
I guess you haven't left? You must like being here. So do I. Hah hah hah!
[Police Chief Kesler]
Oh, the Doom Prayers carry this ^F8081EDoom Token^000000.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
看來你還沒離開啊？你一定很喜歡這裡。我也是，哈哈哈！
[警長凱斯勒]
哦，末日祈禱團會帶著這種^F8081E末日代幣^000000。

scripts.text: What can I get in exchange for Doom
scripts.translation: 末日代幣能換什麼？

scripts.text: Give Doom Tokens.
scripts.translation: 交出末日代幣。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
I remember telling you this when you first brought Doom Tokens, but all right, I don't mind telling you again.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]

謝謝，繼續努力。

scripts.translation:

呃，你剛才不是說有末日代幣嗎？

哦，末日祈禱團會帶著這種^F8081E末日代幣^000000。

Where did you find this?
scripts.translation:

你是在哪裡發現這個的？

scripts.translation: 告訴他你在哪裡找到的。

[Police Chief Kesler]
Thank you so much for helping us to maintain public peace.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
非常感謝你幫忙維護治安。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
You deserve a reward, but I can't think of anything good.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
你應該得到獎勵，可我一時想不到給什麼好。

scripts.text:

Hm...
scripts.translation:

嗯...

scripts.translation:

哦，我想到辦法了！把^F8081E末日代幣^000000交給我，我就用^4E9867封裝信^000000和你交換。

scripts.text: Packing Envelope?
scripts.translation: 封裝信？

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
It's an envelope often discovered in the excavation site.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
那是發掘現場經常發現的一種信封。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Scholars have found out the envelope activates various effects when opened.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
學者們發現，開啟這種信封會觸發各種效果。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Would you like to exchange your Doom Tokens with Packing Envelope now? Or you can do it later.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
現在要用末日代幣兌換封裝信嗎？也可以之後再換。

scripts.text: Exchange now.
scripts.translation: 現在交換。

scripts.text: Do it later.
scripts.translation: 稍後再說。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Sure, no problem. It's not like Doom Tokens have an expiration date.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
當然沒問題，末日代幣又不會過期。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
In exchange for your {0} Doom Tokens, I've given you {1} Packing Envelopes.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
我用你的{0}枚末日代幣，換給你{1}封封裝信。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
Thank you for your continue support in the subjugation of the Doom Prayers.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
感謝你繼續協助討伐末日祈禱團。

scripts.text:
[Police Chief Kesler]
This is the first thing I tell every new visitor: if you see the ^F8081EDoom Prayers^000000, don't hesitate to report to the nearest police station.
scripts.translation:
[警長凱斯勒]
每位新訪客來時，我都會先提醒：看到^F8081E末日祈禱團^000000，立刻向最近的警察局報告。

An error has occurred. If it is the same after retrying, please take a screenshot and ask for the operation.
scripts.translation:

發生錯誤。如果重試後仍然如此，請截圖並聯系運營人員。

Is it right? Is there nothing here, are you nothing?
scripts.translation:

是這樣嗎？這裡什麼都沒有，你也什麼都不是？

scripts.translation:
