呼...呼...

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
Ch-Chief, I'm sorry!
scripts.translation:
[警員薩爾格蘭]
長、長官，對不起！

scripts.text: He's talking in his sleep.
scripts.translation: 他在說夢話。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
You're working a different sector at this moment. Come back when you're done there.
scripts.translation:
[警員薩爾格蘭]
你現在負責的是別的區域。那邊忙完再回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
Are you helping on other things in other areas?...
scripts.translation:
[警員薩爾格蘭]
你正在幫其他區域處理事情嗎？...

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
Haven't you reported to the Captain yet? I told you everything's fine in my sector.
scripts.translation:
[警員薩爾格蘭]
你還沒向隊長彙報嗎？我說過我負責的區域一切正常。

scripts.text: Excuse me.
scripts.translation: 打擾一下。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
Ch-Chief Kesler! I-I wasn't dozing off!
scripts.translation:
[警員薩爾格蘭]
凱、凱斯勒隊長！我、我沒在打瞌睡！

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
...
scripts.translation:
[警員薩爾格蘭]
...

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
Whew, you're not the Chief. Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[警員薩爾格蘭]
呼，還好不是隊長。你是誰？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your chief in the middle of Phantasmagorika sent me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
幻象嘉年華那邊的隊長派我來的。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
Thank goodness, he didn't come himself. He must be busy, eh? Welcome. Could you help me out with something?
scripts.translation:
[警員薩爾格蘭]
謝天謝地，他沒親自來。他肯定很忙吧？歡迎。能幫我個忙嗎？

scripts.text: Help.
scripts.translation: 幫忙。

scripts.text: Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再說。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
You must be busy. All right, then tell the Chief that everything's good in my sector.
scripts.translation:
[警員薩爾格蘭]
你肯定很忙。那請轉告隊長，我負責的區域一切正常。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
Thanks! I've been saddled with some tiresome duties, and I could use your help.
scripts.translation:
[警員薩爾格蘭]
謝了！我被一堆麻煩差事纏住了，正需要你幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
You know the Doom Prayers are in our midst, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[警員薩爾格蘭]
你知道末日祈禱團就在附近活動吧？

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
They've been leaving illegal promotional leaflets all over the place, and whatever paper they used, it sticks to the ground like gum.
scripts.translation:
[警員薩爾格蘭]
他們到處亂貼非法宣傳單，紙張還像口香糖一樣黏在地上。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
I need to get rid of the leaflets before they permanently glue themselves.
scripts.translation:
[警員薩爾格蘭]
我得趁那些傳單徹底黏牢前把它們清掉。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
Could you get rid of them if you see them in the site? They're giving me a headache.
scripts.translation:
[警員薩爾格蘭]
你在現場看到傳單的話，能幫忙清理嗎？看得我頭都疼了。

scripts.text: OK
scripts.translation: 好。

scripts.text: Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再說。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
You must be busy. All right, then tell the Chief that everything's good in my sector.
scripts.translation:
[警員薩爾格蘭]
你肯定很忙。那請轉告隊長，我負責的區域一切正常。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
Thank you. Come back when you get rid of 10 Illegal Leaflets.
scripts.translation:
[警員薩爾格蘭]
謝謝。清理掉10張非法傳單後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
Welcome back. Did the Chief send you again?
scripts.translation:
[警員薩爾格蘭]
歡迎回來。隊長又派你來了？

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
Great, can you help me again to get rid of those illegal leaflets?
scripts.translation:
[警員薩爾格蘭]
太好了，能再幫我清理那些非法傳單嗎？

scripts.text: Help.
scripts.translation: 幫忙。

scripts.text: Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再說。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
Thank you. Come back when you get rid of 10 Illegal Leaflets.
scripts.translation:
[警員薩爾格蘭]
謝謝。清理掉10張非法傳單後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
You must be busy. All right, then tell the Chief that everything's good in my sector.
scripts.translation:
[警員薩爾格蘭]
你肯定很忙。那請轉告隊長，我負責的區域一切正常。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
Wow, I thought you left a minute ago, and you're already back. Did you get rid of the Illegal Leaflets?
scripts.translation:
[警員薩爾格蘭]
哇，我以為你剛走，沒想到這麼快又回來了。非法傳單都清理了嗎？

scripts.text: I did.
scripts.translation: 清理好了。

scripts.text: Where can I find them?
scripts.translation: 我該去哪裡找？

scripts.text: Can I not do this?
scripts.translation: 我能不做嗎？

scripts.text: Never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
Oh, good job! The Chief never forgets a favor. He might reward you more handsomely depending on his mood.
scripts.translation:
[警員薩爾格蘭]
哦，幹得好！隊長從不忘記別人幫過他。他心情好的話，說不定會給你更豐厚的獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
Hmpf, of course no one can be so quick. I asked you to get rid of at least 10 Illegal Leaflets.
scripts.translation:
[警員薩爾格蘭]
哼，哪有這麼快的。至少得清理10張非法傳單。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
They're everywhere in Phantasmagorika. You can't not see them.
scripts.translation:
[警員薩爾格蘭]
幻象嘉年華到處都是傳單，你不可能看不見。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
Do you have some sort of vision problem? There's no way you can miss them.
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
你是不是視力不太好？怎麼可能看不到呢？

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
I want to say no, but I can't force you. Just go tell the Chief that everything's good in my sector.
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
我當然想說不行，但也不能逼你。去告訴隊長，我這邊一切正常吧。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Salgran]
You're silly.
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
你真逗。

Haven't you reported to the Captain yet? I told you everything's fine in my sector.
scripts.translation:

你還沒向隊長彙報嗎？我說過我負責的區域一切正常。

Ugh, I can feel the stress building up inside... Argh, this place is giving me an ulcer!
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
唉，壓力越積越多...啊，這地方快把我愁出胃病了！

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
I feel much better now. Please tell Chief Kesler that everything's good in my sector.
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
現在好多了。請告訴凱斯勒隊長，我負責的區域一切正常。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
Ugh, I'm having stomach cramps. Come back when you're done with your current assignment.
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
唉，我胃抽筋了。完成手頭的任務後再回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
[Police Officer Gerev]
Are you helping in other areas? It's amazing... I just ask for no pressure...
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
你還在其他區域幫忙？真厲害...希望我這邊不要有壓力就好。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
Argh, where's my pen? I had it when I left the station. Did those robots steal it from me?
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
啊，我的筆呢？離開警局時我還拿著。難道被那些機器人偷走了？

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
Hello again. Did the Chief send you?
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
又見面了。是隊長派你來的？

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
Wow, did you already disarm all the traps?
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
哇，陷阱都拆完了嗎？

scripts.text: [Police Officer Gerev]
scripts.translation: [警員格列夫]

scripts.text: He's pulling his hair in agony.
scripts.translation: 他痛苦地揪著自己的頭髮。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
Err? I don't remember putting it there.
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
咦？我不記得把它放那兒了。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
Oops, sorry. How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
哎呀，抱歉。有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your chief in the middle of Phantasmagorika sent me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
幻象嘉年華那邊的隊長派我來的。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
Ah, Chief Kesler sent you. If I didn't know him, I'd have thought he was too busy to come see me. I bet I'm busier than him, though.
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
啊，凱斯勒隊長派你來的。如果我不認識他，還以為他忙得沒空來看我呢。不過我肯定比他更忙。

scripts.text: I can help.
scripts.translation: 我可以幫忙。

scripts.text: Sorry I can't be of help.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我幫不了你。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
You're willing to help the Chief, but not me. Why not because I'm not a chief?
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
你願意幫隊長，卻不願幫我？就因為我不是隊長嗎？

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
*Snort* Just go tell Chief Kesler everything's quiet in my sector.
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
*哼* 去告訴凱斯勒隊長，我負責的區域一切安靜。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
Are you sure? Because I really hate to be disappointed.
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
你確定嗎？我可受不了失望。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
As you know, the Doom Prayers are among us. Grr, just thinking about them makes me grind me teeth.
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
你也知道末日祈禱團就在附近。呃，光想到他們我就恨得咬牙切齒。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
Yesterday I walked over one of their traps and sprained my ankle,
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
昨天我踩到他們的一個陷阱，扭傷了腳踝，

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
on top of everything else that's happened to me.
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
最近倒霉事真是一樁接一樁。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
Sigh, could you disarm their traps?
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
唉，你能幫忙拆掉他們的陷阱嗎？

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 當然可以。

scripts.text: Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再說。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
*Snort* I knew it. Just go tell Chief Kesler everything's quiet in my sector.
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
*哼* 我就知道。去告訴凱斯勒隊長，我負責的區域一切安靜。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
Thank you. Please disarm 10 traps installed in Phantasmagorika.
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
謝謝。請拆除幻象嘉年華里的10個陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
I appreciate it if you can get rid of those in my vicinity first.
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
如果能先拆掉我附近的陷阱，我會很感激。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
If you're not busy, could you disarm the Doom Prayers' traps scattered across Phantasmagorika?
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
有空的話，能幫忙拆掉散佈在幻象嘉年華各處的末日祈禱團陷阱嗎？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 好啊。

scripts.text: Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再說。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
Thank you. Please disarm 10 traps installed in Phantasmagorika.
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
謝謝。請拆除幻象嘉年華里的10個陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
You're just as busy, eh? No worries. I have other adventurers helping me. Please tell Chief Kesler everything's good in my sector.
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
你也很忙啊？沒關係，我還有其他冒險者幫忙。請告訴凱斯勒隊長，我負責的區域一切正常。

scripts.text: I did!
scripts.translation: 我拆完了！

scripts.text: Where are the traps?
scripts.translation: 陷阱在哪裡？

scripts.text: I have a more pressing matter at hand.
scripts.translation: 我還有更急的事要辦。

scripts.text: Never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
Thank you. I feel much better, knowing there are fewer traps around me. Please tell Chief Kesler that everything's well in my sector.
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
謝謝。附近陷阱少了，我心裡也踏實些。請告訴凱斯勒隊長，我負責的區域一切正常。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
I'm already on the verge of a breakdown. You don't have to push.
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
我已經快崩潰了，別再給我壓力了。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
You haven't finished disarming 10 traps. I can see one in front of me. Why don't you start with that?
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
你還沒拆完10個陷阱。我面前就有一個，何不從那個開始？

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
Oh no, haven't you seen any trap at all?
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
糟了，你一個陷阱都沒看到嗎？

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
Look for ??? written on the ground. That's the Doom Prayers' signature.
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
找找地面上寫著“???”的地方，那是末日祈禱團的標記。

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]
I can see one right in front of me. Ugh, my stomach...
scripts.translation:
[警員格列夫]
我面前就有一個。唉，我胃又疼了...

scripts.text:
[Police Officer Gerev]

scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
別這麼說，會招來厄運的。
我可是勇敢的貓，可爪子連那些機器都抓不壞。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Alright, alright.
But don't worry.
I'm not stupid.
I'll never put my charges in danger.
scripts.translation:
[盧克]
好啦好啦，別擔心。
我又不傻，絕不會讓自己保護的人陷入危險。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
You're
looking down your nose at me because I'm a Cat.
Tsk, tsk.
You Humans are so superficial.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
你因為我是隻貓就瞧不起我。
嘖嘖。
人類真膚淺。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
You're looking down your nose at me because I'm a Cat.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
你因為我是隻貓就瞧不起我。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
This place is littered with broken robots and machines.
Clouds of physical energy are discovered near them.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
這裡到處都是損壞的機器人和機器。
它們附近能找到物理能量團。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Oh, this is enough.
You're good.
My estimation of you went up a notch.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
哦，這些就夠了。
幹得不錯。
我對你的評價又高了一點。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Soon I'll need your service on a daily basis.
Don't fret and take one for the team.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
很快我每天都要麻煩你了。
別緊張，就當為團隊出一份力吧。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
You know the drill: collect condensed energy.
You'll do that for me, won't you?
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
你知道該怎麼做：收集凝結能量。
願意幫我吧？

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
All you have to do is collect energy that naturally gathers around the remnants of robots and machines.
I need 10 bottles every day.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
你只要收集機器人和機器殘骸周圍自然聚集的能量就行。
我每天需要10瓶。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
I think I like you!
Not as much as Aures and Luke, though.
All right, I'll make good use of this energy.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
我覺得我開始喜歡你了！
當然還比不上奧雷斯和盧克。
好了，我會好好利用這些能量。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
I'm analyzing the collected energy.
...
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
我正在分析收集來的能量。
...

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Hm, maybe I need to find a special storage method.
The energy dissipates so easily.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
嗯，也許得找種特殊的儲存方法。
這種能量消散得太快了。

scripts.text: [Lloyd]
scripts.translation: [勞埃德]

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Just keep your distance and mind your own business.
You and I will be fine so long as you don't steal my hard work.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
離我遠點，管好自己的事。
只要你不偷我的研究成果，我們就能相安無事。

scripts.text: Are you Lloyd?
scripts.translation: 你是勞埃德嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Yeah. What's up?
Huh? Aures sent you?
To check up on my progress?
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
是啊，怎麼了？
咦？奧雷斯派你來的？
來檢查我的進度？

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Oh, I'm in trouble.
I must live up to his expectations,
but my research has been stagnant.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
啊，這下糟了。
我得達到他的期望，
可研究一直毫無進展。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Hey, could you help
me with something?
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
嘿，能不能幫
我一件事？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然可以。

scripts.text: What is a Cat doing here?
scripts.translation: 貓怎麼會在這裡？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Unlike many from Malangdo Island, I've always been interested in new technologies and cultures.
I worked at companies, and I've learned alchemy.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
和綿綿島上的許多同胞不同，我一直對新科技和文化很感興趣。
我在公司工作過，也學過鍊金術。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
I came to Verus City when I heard the news of its discovery. I was told that I must be in an excavation team to be in the city.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
聽說維魯斯城被發現後，我就趕來了。聽說必須加入發掘隊才能進入。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Aures helped me to get in.
I'm also a member of the Atnad Excavation Team.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
是奧雷斯幫我進來的。
我也是阿特納德發掘隊的成員。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Sorry to interrupt,
but you're from the Eden Group to help the excavation team.
scripts.translation:
[盧克]
抱歉打斷一下，你是樂園團派來協助發掘隊的吧？

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Your job is to help Lloyd.
You can't say no.
scripts.translation:
[盧克]
你的任務就是幫勞埃德。
不準拒絕。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
He's right!
You're obligated to help me with my research!
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
他說得對！
你有義務協助我的研究！

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Let's cut to the chase.
Hey, Human help.
Get 10 empty glass bottles,
and collect condensed energy found around the remnants of robots.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
有話直說吧。
喂，人類幫手，去拿10個空瓶，
再收集機器人殘骸周圍的凝結能量。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
This place is littered with broken robots and machines.
Clouds of physical energy are discovered near them.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
這裡到處都是破損的機器人和機器。
它們附近會出現物理能量團。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Just bring empty bottles close to the energy, and it'll enter the bottles.
Bring me 10 bottles.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
把空瓶靠近能量，它就會裝進瓶裡。
給我帶10瓶來。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
I'll be waiting.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
我等你。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Just bring empty bottles close to the energy, and it'll enter the bottles.
Bring me 10 bottles.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
把空瓶靠近能量，它就會裝進瓶裡。
給我帶10瓶來。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
You must be dumber than you look if you have to ask twice.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
還要問兩遍？你看起來沒這麼笨啊。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
You've made my job easier.
Finally, I can be useful to Aures.
If I find the cause of the condensation of energy and its possible applications, maybe
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
多虧你，我的工作輕鬆多了。
總算能幫上奧雷斯的忙。
如果我找到能量凝結的原因和用途，也許...

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Ian and I can reactivate the robots in this place.
That's what we've wanted all along.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
我和伊恩就能重新啟動這裡的機器人。
這正是我們一直想做的。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Tell Aures I'm making progress.
Good job, Human.
I'll look forward to using your service again.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
告訴奧雷斯我有進展了。
幹得好，人類。
下次還要麻煩你。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 好啊。

scripts.text: Decline.
scripts.translation: 拒絕。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Why, do you have something else to do?
All right then,
I'll ask Luke to take me around.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
怎麼，你還有別的事？
那好吧，
我叫盧克帶我四處看看。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
I thought you'd never ask!
I've been itching for some action.
scripts.translation:
[盧克]
我還以為你永遠不會開口！
我早就手癢了。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
All you have to do is collect energy that naturally gathers around the remnants of robots and machines.
I need 10 bottles every day.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
你只要收集機器人和機器殘骸周圍自然聚集的能量就行。
我每天需要10瓶。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Come back tomorrow.
Well, you might as well come back every day at this time.
You can't say no.
I need you.
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
明天再來吧。
嗯，最好每天這個時候都來。
不準拒絕。
我需要你。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Are you dense?
That means I want to be left alone!
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
你聽不懂嗎？
我說了我想一個人待著！

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
I'll need more bottles of the energy.
How are you?
Are you ready to take one for the team?
scripts.translation:
[勞埃德]
我還需要更多瓶能量。
怎麼樣？
準備好為團隊出力了嗎？

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text: You don't have to collect more energy at this moment.
scripts.translation: 目前不用再收集能量。

scripts.text: You have enough ^4d4dffCondensed Energy^000000.
scripts.translation: 你已經有足夠的^4d4dff凝結能量^000000。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffEmpty Bottle^000000 is required to collect Condensed Energy.
scripts.translation: 收集凝結能量需要^4d4dff空瓶^000000。

scripts.text:
A thick cloud of energy is visible between the broken pieces of metal.
Bring an empty bottle close to the waving edges of the cloud to collect the energy.
scripts.translation:
破碎的金屬間有一團濃厚的能量。
把空瓶靠近能量團搖曳的邊緣，就能收集能量。

scripts.text: Collected Condensed Energy!
scripts.translation: 成功收集到凝結能量！

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Are you heading for Phantasmagorika?
It may be difficult to find. Let me give you some directions.
scripts.translation:
[雷根貝勒衛兵]
你要去幻象嘉年華嗎？
那裡可能不太好找，我給你指個路。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Follow the road all the way up, and then head southwest.
Let me mark the location on your mini-map.
scripts.translation:
[雷根貝勒衛兵]
沿著道路一直往上，再往西南走。
我在小地圖上給你標出位置。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
This place is fraught with formidable monsters, just like the other parts of the old Juperos.
Be safe in your travels.
scripts.translation:
[雷根貝勒衛兵]
這裡和舊朱佩羅斯的其他地方一樣，到處都是強大的魔物。
旅途小心。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Are you heading for Phantasmagorika?
It may be difficult to find. Let me give you some directions.
scripts.translation:
[雷根貝勒衛兵]
你要去幻象嘉年華嗎？
那裡可能不太好找，我給你指個路。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Go straight east, then follow the road south. You'll see a giant status at a corner.
Let me mark the location on your mini-map.
scripts.translation:
[雷根貝勒衛兵]
先一直往東，再沿路向南。拐角處能看到一座巨大的雕像。
我在你的小地圖上標出位置。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Who knew there's a hidden place behind a statue? It was pure luck that we found it.
The road to the place is dangerous. Please have safe travel.
scripts.translation:
[雷根貝勒衛兵]
誰能想到雕像後面藏著一個地方？我們純屬運氣好才發現。
通往那裡的路很危險，路上小心。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Are you a participant of the Phantasmagorika project?
This is the entrance to the newly discovered ruins in the east.
scripts.translation:
[雷根貝勒衛兵]
你是幻象嘉年華髮掘專案的參與者嗎？
這裡就是東邊新發現遺蹟的入口。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
There's a guide on the other side of the entrance to guide you to the excavation site.
Please get in before some monsters pounce on you.
scripts.translation:
[雷根貝勒衛兵]
入口另一邊有嚮導帶你去發掘現場。
趕快進去，別被魔物襲擊了。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Oh, the other side of the entrance is teeming with aggressive robots.
You'd better brace yourself.
scripts.translation:
[雷根貝勒衛兵]
哦，入口另一邊有一大群攻擊性很強的機器人。
做好準備再過去。

scripts.text:
[Excavator Guide]
Are you a participant of the Phantasmagorika project?
As you know, you're at the entrance to Juperos.
scripts.translation:
[發掘嚮導]
你是幻象嘉年華專案的參與者嗎？
如你所知，這裡是朱佩羅斯的入口。

scripts.text:
[Excavator Guide]
I'm here to guide you to the excavation site connected to the inside of Juperos.
scripts.translation:
[發掘嚮導]
我會帶你前往與朱佩羅斯內部相連的發掘現場。

scripts.text:
[Excavator Guide]
There are more guides spread across the inside,
so you can find them easily in case you get lost.
scripts.translation:
[發掘嚮導]
裡面各處還有其他嚮導，
萬一迷路也很容易找到他們。

scripts.text:
[Excavator Guide]
Thank you for your contribution to the development of mankind. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[發掘嚮導]
感謝你為人類發展貢獻力量，祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Are you a member of the Excavation Group?
Our chairman has personally ordered us to see to your safety so that you can focus on your excavation work.
scripts.translation:
[雷根貝勒衛兵]
你是發掘隊成員嗎？
會長親自命令我們保護你，讓你能專心工作。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
We're here to support your excavation of Verus City.
Let us know if you experience any problems.
scripts.translation:
[雷根貝勒衛兵]
我們會協助你們發掘維魯斯城。
遇到任何問題都可以告訴我們。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
I hate using portable johns, but my bladder can't seem to hold very much. What about you?
scripts.translation:
[雷根貝勒衛兵]
我討厭用移動廁所，可膀胱又不太爭氣。你怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Ack! Shoo! Don't come close! I'm saving myself for my future bride!
scripts.translation:
[雷根貝勒衛兵]
啊！走開，別靠近我！我要把自己留給未來的新娘！

scripts.text:
[Geologist]
Hm, the building was crushed by the stone wall.
The rest is almost pulverized to dust.
scripts.translation:
[地質學家]
嗯，這堵石牆把建築壓垮了。
其餘部分幾乎都被碾成粉末。

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Yes, Professor.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
是的，教授。

scripts.text:
[Geologist]
The terrain on which the village stands was formed in a different period, compared to this stone wall. At least that's my initial assessment.
scripts.translation:
[地質學家]
據我初步判斷，村莊所在的地層形成時期和這堵石牆不同。

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Yes, Professor.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
是的，教授。

scripts.text:
[Geologist]
The underground village doesn't seem to be artificial, though I can't imagine how it can be formed naturally. What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[地質學家]
這個地下村莊似乎不是人工建造的，可我實在想不出它如何自然形成。你怎麼看？

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Yes, Professor.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
是的，教授。

scripts.text:
[Geologist]
...Are you even listening to me?
scripts.translation:
[地質學家]
...你到底有沒有在聽我說？

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Yes, Professor.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
是的，教授。

scripts.text:
[Geologist]
Sigh.
Let's go have lunch.
scripts.translation:
[地質學家]
唉。
我們去吃午飯吧。

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Yes, Professor!
scripts.translation:
[助手]
好的，教授！

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Schwarzwald may be the most scientifically advanced among the three states of Midgard, but it still doesn't hold a candle to this place.
scripts.translation:
[學者]
修瓦爾茲巴爾德或許是米德加爾特三國中科學最發達的，但和這裡相比仍遠遠不及。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
The same goes for Juperos. If the scientific knowledge of this place passed down to Schwarzwald, it could have been much more powerful.
scripts.translation:
[學者]
朱佩羅斯也一樣。這裡的科學知識要是能傳到修瓦爾茲巴爾德，他們肯定會強大得多。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Of course, that's based on my theory that the residents of this place were also Schwarzwaldians.
scripts.translation:
[學者]
當然，這得建立在我的理論之上：這裡的居民也是修瓦爾茲巴爾德人。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
I feel like I'm going insane, stuck in this confined space.
Hey, how about I read your fortune for the day with my juggling balls?
scripts.translation:
[皮埃羅]
被困在這麼狹小的地方，我都快瘋了。
嘿，要不要我用雜耍球給你算算今天的運勢？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 好啊。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
Good, choose a color you like.
The color you choose will tell me your fortune.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃羅]
好，選個你喜歡的顏色。
我會根據顏色告訴你今天的運勢。

scripts.text: Red
scripts.translation: 紅色

scripts.text: Blue
scripts.translation: 藍色

scripts.text: Yellow
scripts.translation: 黃色

scripts.text: Green
scripts.translation: 綠色

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
Dum, dum, dum! Your fortune for the day!
Let's me get the fortune paper inside the ball...
scripts.translation:
[皮埃羅]
咚咚咚！來看看你今天的運勢！
讓我從球裡拿出運勢籤...

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
Today is...
scripts.translation:
[皮埃羅]
今天的運勢是...

scripts.text: [Pierrot]
scripts.translation: [皮埃羅]

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
The same boring day, like yesterday and the day before.
Only positive thinking will get you out of this funk. Smile and be nice to others, and maybe Lady Luck will brighten your day.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃羅]
和昨天、前天一樣，又是平平無奇的一天。
積極一點才能走出低潮。保持微笑、善待他人，說不定幸運女神會眷顧你。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
Ack, you shouldn't have gotten out of bed. Wherever you go, trouble follows.
I strongly recommend you stay at the Shelter for the day. Sleep off bad luck.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃羅]
哎呀，你今天就不該起床。走到哪兒都會碰上麻煩。
我強烈建議你今天待在避難所，睡一覺把黴運睡過去。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
Not a bad day, but you'll have to work to enjoy some good luck.
Go to the Excavation Site and dig up some dirt. You may find some treasure.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃羅]
今天還不錯，不過得靠努力才能迎來好運。
去發掘現場挖挖土，說不定能挖到寶藏。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
The luckiest day of your life! Wherever you go, you'll find wealth and friends.
Maybe you'll find some historic artifacts buried in this place. That'll be awesome, huh?
scripts.translation:
[皮埃羅]
這是你一生中最幸運的一天！走到哪兒都能遇見財富和朋友。
說不定還能挖出埋在這裡的歷史文物，太棒了吧？

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
Do you like my reading? Or do you hate it?
Your future is pliable--you can shape it however you want.
Don't get too excited or depressed. Just stay focused on your goal.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃羅]
喜歡我的占卜嗎？還是不喜歡？
未來掌握在你手裡——想怎麼塑造都可以。
別太興奮或沮喪，專心朝目標前進吧。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
All right, come back if you want another reading.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃羅]
好了，想再占卜的話隨時回來。

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
The owner of this house must have been an important figure in Verus City.
Piles of official documents are discovered in this room.
scripts.translation:
[發掘者]
這棟房子的主人肯定是維魯斯城的重要人物。
這個房間裡發現了成堆的公文。

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
Most of the documents contain petty civil complaints, like water problems and neighbor disputes.
All the documents, however, contain the initials, OX. I don't know if they're of a name or an abbreviation of some sort.
scripts.translation:
[發掘者]
大多是些瑣碎的民事投訴，比如供水問題、鄰里糾紛。
不過每份檔案上都有“OX”字樣，不知道是名字還是某種縮寫。

scripts.text: - The building entrance shows distinctive wear and tear, indicating abuse by a steady stream of traffic. YHT and DO NOT YELL are written on the door. -
scripts.translation: - 建築入口有明顯磨損，看來平時人來人往。門上寫著“YHT”和“DO NOT YELL”（禁止大喊）。 -

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
This building is fully furnished, yet there is no sign of habitation.
Maybe the owner lived somewhere else, like in a summer house or something.
scripts.translation:
[發掘者]
這棟房子傢俱齊全，卻沒有人住過的跡象。
主人也許住在別處，比如度假屋。

scripts.text: - ZERT... is written on the door. The rest of the writing looks like it was scratched off with a stone.-
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“ZERT...”，後面的字似乎被石頭刮掉了。 -

scripts.text: - +1 is written on the door. What could it mean? -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“+1”。這是什麼意思呢？ -

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
The owner of this house must have been a dancer. Her wardrobe is full of glittery stage clothes.
Judging by their size, she must have been very tall for a woman. I wonder how she looked like.
scripts.translation:
[發掘者]
這棟房子的主人肯定是舞者，衣櫃裡全是閃亮的舞臺服裝。
看尺寸，她對女性來說應該很高。我真想知道她長什麼樣。

scripts.text: - KDY is written on the door. Sooty streaks that spread outward from the inside to the entrance indicate frequent explosions. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“KDY”。從室內延伸到門口的煙燻痕跡，說明這裡經常發生爆炸。 -

scripts.text: - KJH is written on the door. The entrance wall is dotted with tiny squares of paper containing time and numbers. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“KJH”。入口牆上貼滿了寫著時間和數字的小紙條。 -

scripts.text: - PKY is written on the door. Empty liquor bottles are littered around the house. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“PKY”。屋子裡散落著許多空酒瓶。 -

scripts.text: - DGDG'S BOARD is written on the door. What does that mean? -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“DGDG’S BOARD”。這是什麼意思？ -

scripts.text: - THE SUNS is written on the door. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“THE SUNS”。 -

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
*Cough Cough* The owner of this house was a hoarder.
Lots of books. Lots of cat furballs. Lots of Assassin pictures. *Cough Cough*
scripts.translation:
[發掘者]
*咳咳* 這棟房子的主人真是個囤積狂。
好多書，好多貓毛球，還有好多刺客照片。*咳咳*

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
This house is full of red mushrooms. Are they edible? Why are they only found inside this house? Was the owner farming them?
scripts.translation:
[發掘者]
這屋裡長滿了紅蘑菇。能吃嗎？為什麼只有這棟屋子裡有？主人是在種蘑菇嗎？

scripts.text: - MARES is written on the door, along with various drawings that seem to symbolize pirates. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“MARES”，旁邊畫著各種像是象徵海盜的圖案。 -

scripts.text: - LMH is written on the door, along with a flurry of hearts drawn on an edge. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“LMH”，門邊還畫滿了愛心。 -

scripts.text: - MISA is written on the door. Various toy weapons are littered around the building. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“MISA”。房子周圍散落著各種玩具武器。 -

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
...

[Excavator]
Various pictures are found in this house, all of them featuring the owner with different men.
I find that curious.
scripts.translation:
[發掘者]
屋裡發現了許多照片，每張都是屋主和不同的男人合影。真奇怪。

scripts.text: - ELTOHC is written on the door. In the center of the door is a W drawn in a circle. It could have been the owner's favorite letter. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“ELTOHC”。門中央畫了個圓圈，裡面寫著W。也許這是屋主最喜歡的字母。 -

scripts.text: - LEONA'S BIRD HEAVEN is written on the door. Unsurprisingly, bird feathers are littered around the house. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“LEONA’S BIRD HEAVEN”。屋子裡到處都是鳥羽毛，倒也不奇怪。 -

scripts.text: - KURAT is written on the door. The building wall is littered with hand-drawn skulls. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“KURAT”。牆上畫滿了手繪骷髏。 -

scripts.text: - KSY is written on the door. A poster with The Performance of the Century! boldly printed across it is hung on the entrance wall. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“KSY”。入口牆上掛著一張海報，醒目地寫著“世紀演出！” -

scripts.text: - BIBIC & MORZIP'S LOVE HOUSE is written on the door. A couple must have lived in this house. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“BIBIC & MORZIP’S LOVE HOUSE”。看來曾有一對情侶住在這裡。 -

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
The owner of this house must have been a collector of some sort. There are many pictures of women in strange-looking dresses.
scripts.translation:
[發掘者]
這棟房子的主人肯定是個收藏家，屋裡有很多穿著奇怪裙子的女性照片。

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
Did you see the SKM drawn on the door? That reminds me of the other house with hearts drawn on its door.
I hope it's not one of those childish customs. You know, to mark someone as theirs.
scripts.translation:
[發掘者]
你看到門上的“SKM”了嗎？這讓我想起另一棟門上畫滿愛心的房子。
希望這不是什麼幼稚的標記習俗，比如宣示某人屬於自己之類的。

scripts.text: - HDY is written on the door. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“HDY”。 -

scripts.text: - BRAN is written on the door. Rows of empty bottles are standing on a side of the house. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“BRAN”。房子一側整齊地排著一列列空瓶。 -

scripts.text: - KYH is written on the door. This building is in better condition than the rest in the neighborhood.-
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“KYH”。這棟房子的狀況比街區裡其他房子好得多。 -

scripts.text: - YAOB is written on the door, along with drawings of round, furry animals. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“YAOB”，旁邊畫著圓滾滾、毛茸茸的小動物。 -

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
This house is suspected to belong to a couple named SSUL and SINYC.
The house is filled with incredible things. Everything in it is just gorgeous.
scripts.translation:
[發掘者]
這棟房子據說屬於一對名叫 SSUL 和 SINYC 的伴侶。
裡面有好多不可思議的東西，每一件都精美絕倫。

scripts.text: - LMS is written on the door, along with Composition Specialist on an edge. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“LMS”，邊緣標著“作曲家”。 -

scripts.text: - KJK is written on the door. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“KJK”。 -

scripts.text: - LJH is written on the door. The building wall is covered with numerous grocery store stickers. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“LJH”。牆上貼滿了雜貨店的貼紙。 -

scripts.text: - YG is written on the door. A large picture of a smiling baby is visible through a window. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“YG”。透過窗戶能看到一張大幅的笑臉嬰兒照。 -

scripts.text: - CHJ is written on the door. -
scripts.translation: - 門上寫著“CHJ”。 -

scripts.text:
[Archaeologist]
Sometimes, we gather around to talk.
Sharing information is a part of the job.
scripts.translation:
[考古學家]
有時我們會聚在一起聊聊。
交流資訊也是工作的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
What's the hardest thing about my job?
When I'm forced to eat a terrible lunch provided by my sponsor.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家]
我工作中最難熬的是什麼？
就是被迫吃贊助方提供的難吃午餐。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
In fact, it's been that way since I arrived in Verus City.
Today was not an exception.
scripts.translation:
[歷史學家]
自從來到維魯斯城，我就一直吃這種午餐。
今天也不例外。

scripts.text:
[New Excavator]
I have a lot to learn, and I'm a fast learner.
For now, I'm doing mostly physical tasks.
scripts.translation:
[新發掘者]
我還有很多東西要學，不過學得很快。
目前主要做些體力活。

scripts.text:
[New Excavator]
I'm given free food, a place to sleep, and money. What else can I ask for?
scripts.translation:
[新發掘者]
有免費的飯吃、有地方睡覺，還有錢拿。我還能要求什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Civilization Researcher]
I thought this was a part of Juperos.
I'm now reconsidering that theory.
scripts.translation:
[文明研究員]
我原以為這裡是朱佩羅斯的一部分。
現在我得重新考慮這個理論了。

scripts.text:
[Civilization Researcher]
Verus is similar to Juperos, yet different.
Everything about it is more refined and sophisticated somehow.
scripts.translation:
[文明研究員]
維魯斯和朱佩羅斯有相似之處，卻又不一樣。
這裡的一切似乎都更加精緻、先進。

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
This city's level of mechanical engineering is astonishing.
There's no trace of magic.
scripts.translation:
[科學家]
這座城市的機械工程水平令人驚歎。
看不到任何魔法的痕跡。

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
But I'm concerned:
rapid development and sudden introduction of advanced technology could do more harm than good.
scripts.translation:
[科學家]
不過我有些擔心：
發展太快、突然引入先進技術，帶來的壞處可能大於好處。

scripts.text:
^FF0000- Caution -
- For your safety, -
- avoid running -
- or jumping -
- while inside. -^000000
scripts.translation:
^FF0000- 注意 -
- 為了安全起見， -
- 請勿在室內 -
- 奔跑 -
- 或跳躍。 -^000000

scripts.text:
[Merchant]
Ho ho ho!
I came first, so I took the best spot!
scripts.translation:
[商人]
呵呵呵！
我來得最早，所以佔了最好的位置！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer ?]
*Stomach rumbles*
Aww, I'm hungry...
scripts.translation:
[冒險者？]
*肚子咕咕叫*
哎呀，我餓了...

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
But I have no money to buy food...
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
可我沒錢買吃的...

scripts.text:
[Jean Baljean]
Ugh, I was struck 19 times for a piece of bread.
scripts.translation:
[讓·巴爾讓]
唉，為了一塊麵包，我捱了19下打。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Mushrooms growing out of rocks.
How resilient!
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
蘑菇居然從岩石里長出來了。
生命力真頑強！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Argh!
So many paths are blocked!
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
啊！
好多路都被堵住了！

scripts.text:
[Cow]
*Moo*
scripts.translation:
[奶牛]
*哞*

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Heh. *Drool*
This place is incredible!
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
嘿。*流口水*
這地方真棒！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
This site is amazing.
No wonder why Rekenber called dibs on it.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
這裡真了不起。
難怪雷根貝勒搶先把它佔下來了。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
I want to find something awesome!
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
我想發現點了不起的東西！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
The coming era will be yours.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
未來屬於你。

scripts.text:
[Warning]
Attention visitors of Phantasmagorika,
scripts.translation:
[警告]
幻象嘉年華的訪客請注意：

scripts.text:
[Warning]
a cult group called the Doom Prayers has been frequently sighted in this area.
scripts.translation:
[警告]
名為“末日祈禱團”的邪教組織近期頻繁出現在這一區域。

scripts.text:
[Warning]
If you're a victim or a witness to the group's harassment, please report to the Phantasmagorika Police.
- Phantasmagorika Police Chief -
scripts.translation:
[警告]
如果你是該組織騷擾行為的受害者或目擊者，請向幻象嘉年華警察隊報告。
- 幻象嘉年華警察隊長 -

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Cat]
I must investi... ga... te...
Zzz... Zzz...

[Adventurer Cat]
*Purr*
*Meow*
scripts.translation:
[冒險貓]
*呼嚕*
*喵*

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Cat]
For some reason, I can't stand up.
*Meow*
scripts.translation:
[冒險貓]
不知道為什麼，我站不起來。
*喵*

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Cat]
I've got a good spot.
*Purr*
scripts.translation:
[冒險貓]
我找到好位置了。
*呼嚕*

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Ah!
I want to see!
Why can't I go in?!
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
啊！
我想進去看看！
為什麼不讓我進去？！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
All right!
This time, I'm going to write a report on a field trip to Phantasmagorika.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
好吧！
這次我要寫一篇幻象嘉年華實地考察報告。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Professor Jones will be so impressed he'll give me A+. *Chuckle*
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
瓊斯教授肯定會很滿意，給我A+。*輕笑*

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Toh!
Sound mind, sound body!
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
嘿！
健全的精神寓於健康的身體！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
I'd better pack enough potions for the trip to Phantasmagorika.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
去幻象嘉年華之前，最好多帶些藥水。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
I'm impressed by Rekenber's support.
Um...
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
雷根貝勒真是支援我們啊。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Merchant]
Ooooh!
I've found a perfect spot for my business!
scripts.translation:
[商人]
哦哦！
我找到做生意的絕佳地點了！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Elevator? The scientific advancement of Schwarzwald is astonishing!
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
電梯？修瓦爾茲巴爾德的科技真先進！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
An ancient civilization. Doesn't that sound incredible?
I feel like I can hear ancient machines moving with loud clanking noises.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
古代文明，聽起來多不可思議！
我彷彿都聽見古老機器轟隆作響。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
*Dreamy eyes*
*Gaping mouth*
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
*眼神迷離*
*張大嘴巴*

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Geez, this place is already crammed!
Just looking at these people makes me tired.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
天哪，這裡已經擠爆了！
光看著這些人我就覺得累。

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
It was working fine just a moment ago.
I'm sorry.
I'll have to call in a technician. Please use the stairs instead.
scripts.translation:
[伊萊莎]
剛才還好好的。
真抱歉，我得叫技術人員來修。請先走樓梯吧。

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
^0000FFPhantasmagorika is past the tunnel to the south from the southeast gate outside Juperos Ruins.^000000
scripts.translation:
[伊萊莎]
^0000FF幻象嘉年華位於朱佩羅斯遺蹟東南門外隧道的南側。^000000

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
There are elevator doors near the fountain in the center of the place. Could you check what happened to the elevator?
scripts.translation:
[伊萊莎]
這裡中央的噴泉附近有電梯門。能幫我看看電梯出了什麼問題嗎？

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text: - Someone died! -
scripts.translation: - 有人受傷了！ -

scripts.text: - Unfortunately, the person who died stuck in the elevator door, and the elevator that opened and closed constantly stuck to him.. -
scripts.translation: - 不幸的是，那個人卡在電梯門裡，被不斷開合的電梯夾住了... -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you ok?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你還好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fallen Man]
......
scripts.translation:
[倒地男子]
...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Can you hear me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你聽得到我說話嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fallen Man]
...Leave me alone...
scripts.translation:
[倒地男子]
...別管我...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What?

[Fallen Man]
I am fine, let me go..
scripts.translation:
[倒地男子]
我沒事，讓我走...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But you don't look like it's nothing...
Wait here,
I will help you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但你看起來傷得不輕...
在這裡等著，
我來幫你。

scripts.text:
[Fallen Man]
Just telling you that I dont... Hey! My waist!!!
scripts.translation:
[倒地男子]
我只是想說我沒...喂！我的腰！！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will help you find a doctor!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我去幫你找醫生！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Man]
Excuse me, thank you.
scripts.translation:
[倒地男子]
麻煩你了，謝謝。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text: later, the boys lying on the stretcher were embarrassed and suddenly grabbed my hand..
scripts.translation: 後來，擔架上的男孩有些不好意思，突然抓住了我的手...

scripts.text: Later, the boy lying on the stretcher looked embarrassed and suddenly put a small fruit in my hand..
scripts.translation: 後來，擔架上的男孩顯得有些靦腆，突然把一個小水果塞到我手裡...

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
Weird!! How can the elevator suddenly move again?
maybe the following people have something to do?
scripts.translation:
[伊萊莎]
真奇怪！！電梯怎麼突然又能動了？
難道和下面那幾個人有關？

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
My company Rekenber is in partnership with the Eden Group
for the ^0000FFPhantasmagorika excavation project^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊萊莎]
我的公司雷根貝勒正與樂園團
合作開展^0000FF幻象嘉年華髮掘專案^000000。

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
The newly discovered legacy of the ancients: Phantasmagorika!
Contact the ^0000FFEden Group^000000 to join its Phantasmagorika excavation project!
scripts.translation:
[伊萊莎]
古代遺蹟新發現：幻象嘉年華！
聯絡^0000FF樂園團^000000，加入幻象嘉年華髮掘專案！

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
Good day.
Please say your name, so I can check your registration.
scripts.translation:
[伊萊莎]
您好。
請告訴我您的名字，我來確認登記資訊。

scripts.text: Say your name.
scripts.translation: 報上名字。

scripts.text: Ask about the registration.
scripts.translation: 詢問登記事宜。

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話。

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
Um, let's see...
I'm sorry, but you're not on the list. Could you check your registration status?
scripts.translation:
[伊萊莎]
嗯，我查檢視...
抱歉，名單上沒有你。能確認一下登記狀態嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
You're back already.
scripts.translation:
[伊萊莎]
你這麼快就回來了。

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
It was working fine just a moment ago.
I'm sorry.
I'll have to call in a technician. Please use the stairs instead.
scripts.translation:
[伊萊莎]
剛才還好好的。

scripts.text:
[Leitner]
Heya!
What brings you here, sweetheart?
If you're looking for a shoulder to cry on, I'm here.
scripts.translation:
[萊特納]
嗨！
有什麼事嗎，親愛的？
如果你想找個肩膀哭一場，我就在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Leitner]
I know, I know; why the extra step when the elevator is open to the public?
scripts.translation:
[萊特納]
我知道，我知道；既然電梯對公眾開放，為什麼還要多這一步呢？

scripts.text:
[Leitner]
The elevator breaks almost every day, probably from carrying too many people.
Ah, I need rest. Sigh.
scripts.translation:
[萊特納]
電梯幾乎每天都壞，大概是載了太多人吧。
啊，我需要休息。嘆氣。

scripts.text: Ask about the registration process.
scripts.translation: 詢問登記流程

scripts.text:
[Leitner]
Oh.
I should have known.
You mean the elevator to Phantasmagorika, eh?
scripts.translation:
[萊特納]
哦。
我早該想到的。
你是說去幻影魔境的那部電梯，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Leitner]
When I first got this job, the elevator was private and I did diddly-squat.
scripts.translation:
[萊特納]
我剛接手這份工作的時候，電梯是私人的，我幾乎什麼都不用做。

scripts.text:
[Leitner]
Then, the management opened it to the public and my life went straight to hell.
scripts.translation:
[萊特納]
後來，管理層把它對公眾開放了，我的生活簡直變成了地獄。

scripts.text:
[Leitner]
Ah, why me?!
Goodbye, peaceful days!
I'm so busy that I barely have time for the ladies.
scripts.translation:
[萊特納]
啊，為什麼是我？！
再見了，平靜的日子！
我忙得連陪女士們的時間都沒有了。

scripts.text:
[Leitner]
Anyway, let's get you registered. I want to get back to my break.
Err... Write down your name here, and put your fingerprint next to it.
Done. Easy, huh?
scripts.translation:
[萊特納]
總之，讓我們先把你登記好。我想趕緊回去休息。
呃...在這裡寫下你的名字，然後在旁邊按個指紋。
好了。很簡單吧？

scripts.text:
[Leitner]
I know, I know; why the extra step when the elevator is open to the public?
scripts.translation:

好了，

Hey! That has been solved!

嘿！已經解決了！
嘿...抱歉，我不該笑的，但這真的很好笑...哦...

This facility is provided by ^0000FFRekenber^000000

scripts.text:

What did you do in the elevator?

[斯嘉麗]
你在電梯裡做了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Scarlet]
Careful!
Everyone, stop moving!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗]
小心！
大家，停止移動！

Good day.
Please say your name, so I can check your registration.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗]
日安。
請報上您的名字，以便我核對您的登記資訊。

to ^0000FFthe members of the Eden Group^000000 for their safe transportation to ^0000FFPhantasmagorika^000000.

您可以在^0000FF雷根貝勒總部^000000登記使用本設施，前提是您必須是樂園團已登記的挖掘者。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet]

scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗]
登記完成後，請在使用設施前再次確認您的登記狀態。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet]
I told you not to run or jump inside the elevator!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗]
我告訴過你，不要在電梯裡跑跳！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet]
I can't believe you crushed the doors!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗]
真不敢相信，你把門都撞壞了！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
It's my fault.
I should have kept a tight rein on him.
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
這是我的錯。
我應該好好管住他的。

scripts.text:
[Du]
How do you expect me to trust myself to such a shoddy machine?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
你怎麼能讓我信任這麼破舊的機器？

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Enough!
Apologize to the lady!
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
夠了！
向女士道歉！

scripts.text:
[Du]
But he started it...
scripts.translation:
[杜]
但他先動手的...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I told you stop jumping!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我告訴過你停止跳！

scripts.text:
[Alph]
You guys,
stop fighting.
The floor feels dangerously unstable.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
你們，
別吵了。
地板感覺很不穩定，很危險。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet]
We all should get off and call in a techni...
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗]
我們大家都應該下車，然後呼叫技...

scripts.text:
[Maggi]
Kyaaaaah-!
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬]
呀啊啊啊-！

scripts.text:
[Du]
Wah!
The floor rattled!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
哇！
地板在晃動！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet]
Stop!
Everyone, stay still!
Or we might plummet to the bottom!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗]
停下！
大家，保持靜止！
否則我們可能會墜落到最底部！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet]
Hey,
you!
Help!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗]
嘿，
你！
幫幫忙！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet]
This elevator is so unstable that none of us can move.
Could you bring us something to ^0000FFsupport the floor^000000?
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗]
這部電梯太不穩定了，我們誰都無法移動。
你能給我們帶點東西來^0000FF支撐地板^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Scarlet]
We don't have time to wait for a technician!
We just need ^FF000030 Used Iron Plates from Dimiks^000000 in Juperos!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗]
我們沒有時間等技術人員了！
我們需要^FF000030塊來自冰凍迪靡克的老舊鐵板^000000，就在朱佩羅斯！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet]
Please help us!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗]
請幫幫我們！

scripts.text:
[Du]
WAH-!
We're going to crash to the ground!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
哇-！
我們要墜落到地面了！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Don't say that!
This is your fault!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
別這麼說！
這是你的錯！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet]
Quiet, both of you!
If you move an inch, we are all going to die!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗]
安靜，你們兩個！
如果你們動一下，我們全都要死！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet]
This elevator is so unstable that none of us can move.
Could you bring us something to ^0000FFsupport the floor^000000?
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗]
這部電梯太不穩定了，我們誰都無法移動。
你能給我們帶點東西來^0000FF支撐地板^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Scarlet]
We don't have time to wait for a technician!
We just need ^FF000030 Used Iron Plates from Dimiks^000000 in Juperos!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗]
我們沒有時間等技術人員了！
我們需要^FF000030塊來自冰凍迪靡克的老舊鐵板^000000，就在朱佩羅斯！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet]
Please help us!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗]
請幫幫我們！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet]
Did you bring Used Iron Plates?
Please push them in here carefully, one by one.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗]
你帶老舊鐵板來了嗎？
請小心地，一塊一塊地推進來。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet]
They might not hold for long, but that should still be enough us to get out.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗]
它們可能撐不了多久，但應該足夠我們逃出去了。

scripts.text: Push in Used Iron Plates.
scripts.translation: 推入老舊鐵板

scripts.text:
[Scarlet]
Now, get off!
The plates won't hold for long!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗]
現在，下車！
鐵板撐不了多久了！

scripts.text:
[Du]
Thank the gods!
Here, Maggi!
Take my hand and get down.
scripts.translation:
[杜]
謝天謝地！
來，瑪姬！
抓住我的手，下來。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet]
Whew...
I'm glad no one's hurt.
I'll let this go,
but never again!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗]
呼...
幸好沒人受傷。
這次就算了，
下次絕不允許再這樣！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet]
And {0}, thank you so much.
We could have been in big trouble if it weren't for you.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗]
還有{0}，非常感謝你。
如果不是因為你，我們可能會陷入大麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet]
I've just heard from Elisha.
You had to walk because the elevator was broken, right?
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗]
我剛從伊萊莎那裡聽說。
因為電梯壞了，你不得不步行，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Scarlet]
I'm sorry for the inconvenience.
The elevator is back in operation now. Let me know if you want to go up.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉麗]
抱歉給您帶來不便。
電梯現在已經恢復運行了。如果您想上去，請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Whew! {0}, you've saved us.
Sigh, I don't know when he's going to grow up.
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
呼！{0}，你救了我們。
唉，真不知道他什麼時候才能長大。

scripts.text:
[Maggi]
*Sob* *Hiccup*
Th-thanks... *Sob* *Hiccup*
I was so scared! Wah-!
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬]
*抽泣* *打嗝*
謝...謝謝... *抽泣* *打嗝*
我嚇死了！哇——！

scripts.text:
[Du]
...Sorry.

[Tamarin]
Thank you.
Sigh, I don't want to imagine what might have happened if you, {0}, didn't pass by at that moment.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
謝謝你。
唉，我不敢想像如果那一刻沒有你，{0}，會發生什麼事。

scripts.text:
[Alph]
...Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
...謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
By the way, don't you think it's strange
that an elevator is set up and running in the newly discovered ruins?

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

Wait.

[Mark]
Do you see the giant machine ahead of us?
Unlike the first place, this place is filled with giant machines.

Buildings are crumbled. The ground is caved in here and there.
scripts.translation:
[馬克]

scripts.text:
[Mark]
I've found a path over there, though it's blocked.
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
我在那邊發現了一條路，不過被堵住了。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
That doesn't bode well.
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
這可不是好兆頭。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Oh, Tamarin!
Don't go over there!

[馬克]
哦，塔馬林！
別去那邊！

[Tamarin]
Look over there.
That part of the place is completely destroyed.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
看那邊。
那部分地方完全被摧毀了。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Maggi, how's it like over there?
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
瑪姬，那邊情況怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Maggi]
Oh.
The path over here is also blocked.
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬]
哦。
這邊的路也被堵住了。

scripts.text:
[Maggi]
I'm sensing some kind of current on the other side,
but I can't tell exactly what.
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬]
我感覺到那邊有一股氣流，
但具體是什麼還說不清楚。

scripts.text:
[Maggi]
It doesn't feel like a living thing,
but it's strong just the same.
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬]
感覺不像是有生命的東西，
但力量依然很強。

scripts.text:
[Du]
Um.
I really don't want to go over there.
scripts.translation:
[杜]
嗯。
我真的不想去那邊。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
...!
That's a first. You earned the nickname Red-haired Boar because you never stop running.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
...!
真是頭一回。你得了“紅髮野豬”這個綽號，就是因為從來沒停過腳步。

scripts.text:
[Du]
No one calls me that!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
沒人這麼叫我！

scripts.text:
[Du]
I've got cooler nicknames! Call me those!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
我有更酷的綽號！叫那個！

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Du.
Don't insult boars.
All their parts, from head to toe, are useful.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
杜。
別侮辱野豬。
它們從頭到腳，每一部分都有用。

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Delicious, too.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
而且很好吃。

scripts.text:
[Du]
That's not the point!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
重點不是這個！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Du's instinct has never betrayed us. We should steer clear of that path.
Right, Boar?
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
杜的直覺從來沒讓我們失望過。我們應該避開那條路。
對吧，野豬？

scripts.text:
[Du]
Grr!
I said
don't call me that!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
哼！
我說了
別這麼叫我！

scripts.text:
[Alph]
The path is blocked, and if the Phantasmagorika Excavation Team hasn't cleared it, then there must be a reason. Let's steer clear of it until we find out more about it.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
路被堵住了，如果幻影挖掘隊沒有清理它，那肯定有原因。在弄清楚更多情況之前，讓我們避開它吧。

scripts.text:
[Du]
Don't you make fun of me!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
別取笑我！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
I agree.
Let's check the other places first.
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
我同意。
讓我們先檢查其他地方。

[Reward Coordinator]
So, um... I'm...

to... to... Let me think...
